title.zh: 卷四 本紀第四: 太宗下
title.raw: 卷四 本紀第四: 太宗下 Volume 4 Annals 4: Taizong 2

sentences.zh: 太宗下

translations.literal: Taizong, Part Two
translations.idiomatic: Taizong, Part Two

sentences.zh: 三月壬戌，將東幸，三克言農務方興，請減輜重，促還朝，從之。

translations.literal: In the third month, on day renxu, he was about to travel east on tour; Sanko said agricultural work was just beginning, requested reducing the baggage train, and urged return to court — it was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on renxu day, as he prepared to tour eastward, Sanko argued that the spring planting was only just underway, asked that supply wagons be cut back, and pressed for an early return to court; the Emperor agreed.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，女直來貢。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, the Jurchen came to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day the Jurchen brought tribute.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，東幸。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, he traveled east on tour.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day he set out on an eastern tour.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊寅朔，如南京。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the wuyin new moon, he went to the Southern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: That summer, on the wuyin new moon of the fourth month, he went to the Southern Capital.

sentences.zh: 甲申，女直來貢。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, the Jurchen came to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day the Jurchen brought tribute.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，幸溫泉。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, he visited the hot springs.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day he visited the hot springs.

sentences.zh: 己丑，還宮，朝于皇太后。

translations.literal: On day jichou, he returned to the palace and attended court before the Grand Empress Dowager.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day he returned to the palace and paid court to the Grand Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，女直貢弓矢。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, the Jurchen presented bows and arrows as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day the Jurchen presented bows and arrows in tribute.

sentences.zh: 己亥，西南邊大詳穩耶律魯不古奏党項捷。

translations.literal: On day jihai, Grand Xiangwen Yelü Lubugu of the southwest frontier reported a Tangut victory.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day Yelü Lubugu, grand xiangwen on the southwest frontier, reported a victory over the Tangut.

sentences.zh: 五月甲寅，晉復遣使請上尊號，從之。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on day jiayin, Jin again sent envoys requesting elevated titles; it was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jiayin day, Jin again sent envoys asking that honorific titles be conferred; the court assented.

sentences.zh: 六月丙子朔，吐谷渾及女直東貢。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the bingzi new moon, Tuyuhun and the eastern Jurchen came to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi new moon of the sixth month, Tuyuhun and the eastern Jurchen brought tribute.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，南唐來貢。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, Southern Tang came to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day Southern Tang sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，詔建日月四時堂，圖寫古帝王事于兩廡。

translations.literal: On day guisi, an edict ordered building the Hall of Sun, Moon, and Four Seasons, with portraits of ancient emperors and kings painted on both side corridors.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day an edict ordered construction of the Hall of Sun, Moon, and Four Seasons, with the deeds of ancient emperors and kings painted along both side corridors.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸亥，遣使賜晉馬。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on day guihai, envoys were dispatched to present horses to Jin.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn, in the seventh month on guihai day, envoys were sent to present horses to Jin.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，遣鶻離底使晉，梅里了古使南唐。

translations.literal: On day dingmao, Gulidi was dispatched as envoy to Jin, and Meiligu to Southern Tang.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day Gulidi was sent as envoy to Jin and Meiligu to Southern Tang.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，遣中台省右相耶律述蘭迭烈哥使晉，臨海軍節度使趙思溫副之，冊晉帝為英武明義皇帝。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, Central Secretariat Vice Chancellor Yelü Shulan Dielige was dispatched as envoy to Jin, with Linhai Army Military Governor Zhao Siwen as deputy, to invest the Jin Emperor with the title Heroic Martial and Brightly Righteous Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day Yelü Shulan Dielige, vice chancellor of the Central Secretariat, was dispatched to Jin with Linhai Army Military Governor Zhao Siwen as deputy to invest the Jin Emperor as the Heroic Martial and Brightly Righteous Emperor.

sentences.zh: 八月戊子，女直來貢。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on day wuzi, the Jurchen came to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on wuzi day, the Jurchen brought tribute.

sentences.zh: 庚子，吐谷渾、烏孫、靺鞨皆來貢。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, Tuyuhun, Wusun, and Mohe all came to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day Tuyuhun, Wusun, and Mohe all sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 九月庚戌，黑車子室韋貢名馬。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on day gengxu, the Heichezi Shiwei presented famed horses as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on gengxu day, the Heichezi Shiwei presented famed horses.

sentences.zh: 邊臣奏晉遣守司空馮道、左散騎常侍韋勛來上皇太后尊號，左僕射劉昫、右諫議大夫盧重上皇帝尊號，遂遣監軍寅你已充接伴。

translations.literal: Border officials reported that Jin had dispatched Acting Minister of Works Feng Dao and Left Regular Attendant of the Drafting Office Wei Xun to present the Grand Empress Dowager's elevated title, and Left Vice Director Liu Xu and Right Remonstrance Office Grandee Lu Chong to present the Emperor's elevated title; Military Commissioner Yinniyi was then dispatched to serve as reception host.
translations.idiomatic: Frontier officials reported that Jin had sent Acting Minister of Works Feng Dao and Left Regular Attendant Wei Xun to invest the Grand Empress Dowager, and Left Vice Director Liu Xu and Right Remonstrance Grandee Lu Chong to invest the Emperor; Military Commissioner Yinniyi was then appointed to receive them.

sentences.zh: 壬子，詔群臣及高年，凡授大臣爵秩，皆賜錦袍、金帶、白馬、金飾鞍勒，著于令。

translations.literal: On day renzi, an edict directed that for ministers and elders, whenever great ministers were granted ranks and titles, all were to be given brocade robes, gold belts, white horses, and gold-trimmed saddles and bridles — written into statute.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day an edict declared that whenever ministers and elders received high rank, they were to be granted brocade robes, gold belts, white horses, and gold-trimmed saddles and bridles — and this was entered into law.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲戌朔，遣郎君迪里姑等撫問晉使。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the jiaxu new moon, Langjun Diligu and others were dispatched to console and inquire after the Jin envoys.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, on the jiaxu new moon of the tenth month, Langjun Diligu and others were sent to visit and comfort the Jin envoys.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，晉遣使來謝冊禮。

translations.literal: On day renyin, Jin sent envoys to thank him for the investiture rites.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day Jin sent envoys to thank him for the investiture ceremonies.

sentences.zh: 是日，復有使進獨峰駝及名馬。

translations.literal: That same day another envoy came presenting single-hump camels and famed horses.
translations.idiomatic: That same day another envoy arrived with single-hump camels and famed horses.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲辰朔，命南北宰相及夷離堇就館賜晉使馮道以下宴。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the jiachen new moon, the Northern and Southern Chancellors and yilijins were ordered to bestow a banquet at the guesthouse on the Jin envoys Feng Dao and the rest.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen new moon of the eleventh month, the Northern and Southern Chancellors and the yilijins were ordered to host a banquet at the guesthouse for Feng Dao and the other Jin envoys.

sentences.zh: 丙午，上御開皇殿，召見晉使。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, the Emperor took his seat in Kaihuang Hall and summoned the Jin envoys for audience.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day the Emperor received audience in Kaihuang Hall and summoned the Jin envoys before him.

sentences.zh: 壬子，皇太后御開皇殿，馮道、韋勛冊上尊號曰廣德至仁昭烈崇簡應天皇太后。

translations.literal: On day renzi, the Grand Empress Dowager took her seat in Kaihuang Hall; Feng Dao and Wei Xun invested her with the elevated title Grand Empress Dowager of Broad Virtue, Utmost Benevolence, Bright Splendor, Lofty Simplicity, and Response to Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day the Grand Empress Dowager sat in Kaihuang Hall while Feng Dao and Wei Xun invested her as Grand Empress Dowager of Broad Virtue, Utmost Benevolence, Bright Splendor, Lofty Simplicity, and Response to Heaven.

sentences.zh: 甲子，行再生柴冊禮。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, the regeneration firewood-pledge rite was performed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day he performed the regeneration investiture rite.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，皇帝御宣政殿，劉昫、盧重冊上尊號曰睿文神武法天啟運明德章信至道廣敬昭孝嗣聖皇帝。

translations.literal: On day bingyin, the Emperor took his seat in the Hall of Promulgating Governance; Liu Xu and Lu Chong invested him with the elevated title Emperor of Sagacious Letters, Divine Martial Prowess, Aligning with Heaven's Law, Opening Fortune, Bright Virtue and Manifest Faith, Utmost Way, Broad Reverence, Bright Filial Piety, and Successor Sage.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day the Emperor sat in the Hall of Promulgating Governance while Liu Xu and Lu Chong invested him as Emperor of Sagacious Letters, Divine Martial Prowess, Aligning with Heaven's Law, Opening Fortune, Bright Virtue and Manifest Faith, Utmost Way, Broad Reverence, Bright Filial Piety, and Successor Sage.

sentences.zh: 大赦，改元會同。

translations.literal: A general amnesty was declared; the era name was changed to Huitong.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed and the era name changed to Huitong.

sentences.zh: 是月，晉復遣趙瑩奉表來賀，以幽、薊、瀛、莫、涿、檀、順、媯、儒、新、武、雲、應、朔、寰、蔚十六州並圖籍來獻。

translations.literal: That month Jin again dispatched Zhao Ying bearing a memorial of congratulation, presenting You, Ji, Ying, Mo, Zhuo, Tan, Shun, Gui, Ru, Xin, Wu, Yun, Ying, Shuo, Huan, and Wei — sixteen prefectures together with maps and registers.
translations.idiomatic: That month Jin again sent Zhao Ying with a letter of congratulation, offering sixteen prefectures — You, Ji, Ying, Mo, Zhuo, Tan, Shun, Gui, Ru, Xin, Wu, Yun, Ying, Shuo, Huan, and Wei — together with their maps and registers.

sentences.zh: 於是詔以皇都為上京，府曰臨潢。

translations.literal: Thereupon an edict designated the imperial capital as Supreme Capital, its prefecture named Linhuang.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon an edict raised the imperial capital to Supreme Capital and named its prefecture Linhuang.

sentences.zh: 升幽州為南京，南京為東京。

translations.literal: Youzhou was raised to Southern Capital; the Southern Capital was raised to Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: Youzhou was promoted to Southern Capital, and the former Southern Capital became Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 改新州為奉聖州，武州為歸化州。

translations.literal: Xin Prefecture was renamed Fengsheng Prefecture; Wu Prefecture was renamed Guihua Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Xin Prefecture was renamed Fengsheng, and Wu Prefecture was renamed Guihua.

sentences.zh: 升北、南二院及乙室夷離堇為王，以主簿為令，令為刺史，刺史為節度使，二部梯里己為司徒，達剌干為副使，麻都不為縣令，縣達剌干為馬步。

translations.literal: The Northern and Southern Courts and the Yishi yilijin were raised to princes; chief clerks became magistrates, magistrates became prefects, prefects became military governors; tribal chiefs became Ministers of Work, darqan became deputy commissioners, madu became county magistrates, and county darqan became cavalry and infantry commanders.
translations.idiomatic: The Northern and Southern Courts and the Yishi yilijin were ennobled as princes; chief clerks were made magistrates, magistrates prefects, prefects military governors; tribal chiefs became Ministers of Work, darqan deputy commissioners, madu county magistrates, and county darqan cavalry and infantry commanders.

sentences.zh: 置宣徽、閤門使、控鶴、客省、御史大夫、中丞、侍御、判官、文班牙署、諸宮院世燭，馬群、遙輦世燭，南北府、國舅帳郎君官為敞史，諸部宰相、節度使帳為司空，二室韋闥林為僕射，鷹坊、監冶等局官長為詳穩。

translations.literal: Posts were established for Xuanhui, Gatekeepers, Crane Control, Guest Reception, Censor-in-Chief, Vice Censor, Attending Censor, Adjudicator, Literary Shift Attendants, palace bureaus' hereditary candles, horse herds and Imperial Carriage hereditary candles; Northern and Southern Court and imperial uncle account Langjun posts became chamberlains; every department's chancellor and military governor accounts became Ministers of Work; Ershiwei Talin became Pushe; Eagle Yard, Foundry Supervision, and similar bureau chiefs became xiangwen.
translations.idiomatic: Offices were set up for Xuanhui, Gatekeepers, Crane Control, Guest Reception, Censor-in-Chief, Vice Censor, Attending Censor, Adjudicator, Literary Shift Attendants, palace bureaus' hereditary candles, horse herds and Imperial Carriage hereditary candles; Langjun posts in the Northern and Southern Courts and the imperial uncle's household became chamberlains; chancellor and military governor households in every department became Ministers of Work; Ershiwei Talin was made Pushe; and chiefs of the Eagle Yard, Foundry Supervision, and like bureaus became xiangwen.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊戌，遣同括、阿缽等使晉，制加晉馮道守太傅，劉昫守太保，餘官各有差。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on day wuxu, Tongkuo, Abo, and others were dispatched as envoys to Jin; by decree Feng Dao of Jin was made Acting Grand Tutor, Liu Xu Acting Grand Preceptor, and other offices each differing in rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on wuxu day, Tongkuo, Abo, and others were sent as envoys to Jin; by decree Feng Dao of Jin was appointed Acting Grand Tutor, Liu Xu Acting Grand Preceptor, and the remaining offices were adjusted each according to rank.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月乙巳，以受晉冊，遣使報南唐、高麗。

translations.literal: In the second year, in the first month of spring, on day yisi, because he had received Jin's investiture, envoys were dispatched to notify Southern Tang and Goryeo.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, on yisi day in the first month of spring, envoys were sent to notify Southern Tang and Goryeo of his acceptance of Jin's investiture.

sentences.zh: 丁未，御開皇殿，宴晉使馮道以下，賜物有差。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, he took his seat in Kaihuang Hall, feasted the Jin envoys Feng Dao and below, and bestowed gifts differing in grade.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day he held court in Kaihuang Hall, feasted Feng Dao and the other Jin envoys, and bestowed gifts of varying grade.

sentences.zh: 戊申，晉遣金吾衛大將軍馬從斌、考功郎中劉知新來貢珍幣，命分賜群臣。

translations.literal: On day wushen, Jin dispatched Gold Crow Guard General Ma Congbin and Director of Personnel Liu Zhixin with precious gifts; they were ordered distributed among the ministers.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day Jin sent Gold Crow Guard General Ma Congbin and Director of Personnel Liu Zhixin with precious tribute; the Emperor ordered the gifts divided among his ministers.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，晉遣使謝免沿邊四州錢幣。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, Jin sent envoys thanking him for exempting the four frontier prefectures from coin tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day Jin sent envoys to thank him for remitting coin tribute from the four frontier prefectures.

sentences.zh: 二月戊寅，宴諸王及節度使來賀受冊禮者，仍命皇太子、惕隱迪輦餞之。

translations.literal: In the second month, on day wuyin, he feasted the princes and military governors who had come to congratulate on receiving the investiture, and ordered the Crown Prince and tixin Dilian to see them off with a parting feast.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on wuyin day, he feasted the princes and military governors who had come to congratulate him on the investiture, and ordered the Crown Prince and tixin Dilian to give them a farewell banquet.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，謁太祖廟，賜在京吏民物，及內外群臣官賞有差。

translations.literal: On day guisi, he visited the Taizu temple, bestowed goods on officials and people in the capital, and granted rewards to inner and outer ministers differing in grade.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day he visited the Taizu temple, distributed goods to officials and commoners in the capital, and granted rewards of varying grade to ministers within and without the court.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，加兼侍中、左金吾衛上將軍王鄑檢校太尉。

translations.literal: On day dingyou, Wang Ji, concurrently Palace Attendant and General-in-Chief of the Left Gold Crow Guard, was made Acting Grand Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day Wang Ji, who also served as Palace Attendant and General-in-Chief of the Left Gold Crow Guard, was appointed Acting Grand Commandant.

sentences.zh: 三月，畋于褭潭之則。

translations.literal: In the third month, he hunted at the border of Niaotan Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month he hunted along the shore of Niaotan Marsh.

sentences.zh: 戊申，女直來貢。

translations.literal: On day wushen, the Jurchen came to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day the Jurchen brought tribute.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，封皇子述律為壽安王，罨撒葛為太平王。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, Prince Shulü was enfeoffed as Prince of Shou'an, and Yansage as Prince of Taiping.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day Prince Shulü was enfeoffed as Prince of Shou'an and Yansage as Prince of Taiping.

sentences.zh: 己巳，大賚百姓。

translations.literal: On day jisi, a great distribution of gifts was made to the common people.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day the common people received a great distribution of gifts.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙亥，幸木葉山。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on day yihai, he visited Mount Muye.
translations.idiomatic: That summer, in the fourth month on yihai day, he visited Mount Muye.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，東京路奏狼食人。

translations.literal: On day guisi, the Eastern Capital Circuit reported wolves eating people.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day the Eastern Capital Circuit reported that wolves had killed people.

sentences.zh: 五月乙巳，禁南京鬻牝羊出境。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on day yisi, selling female sheep outside the Southern Capital was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on yisi day, the sale of ewes beyond the Southern Capital was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 思奴古多里等坐盜官物，籍其家。

translations.literal: Sinuguduo Li and others, guilty of stealing government goods, had their households registered for confiscation.
translations.idiomatic: Sinuguduo Li and others, convicted of stealing government property, had their households registered and their goods seized.

sentences.zh: 南唐遣使來貢。

translations.literal: Southern Tang dispatched envoys to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Southern Tang sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以所貢物賜群臣。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, the tribute goods were bestowed on the ministers.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day the tribute goods were distributed among the ministers.

sentences.zh: 戊申，回鶻單于使人乞授官，詔第加刺史、縣令。

translations.literal: On day wushen, Uyghur Chanyu envoys requested offices; by edict they were granted in succession the ranks of prefect and county magistrate.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day envoys of the Uyghur Chanyu asked for offices; by edict they were promoted in turn to prefect and county magistrate.

sentences.zh: 六月丁丑，雨雪。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on day dingchou, rain and snow fell.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on dingchou day, rain and snow fell.

sentences.zh: 是夏，駐蹕頻蹕淀。

translations.literal: That summer the court encamped at Pinbi Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: That summer the court encamped at Pinbi Marsh.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊申，晉遣使進犀帶。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on day wushen, Jin sent envoys presenting rhinoceros horn belts.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn, in the seventh month on wushen day, Jin sent envoys with rhinoceros-horn belts.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，吐谷渾來貢。

translations.literal: On day gengxu, Tuyuhun came to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day Tuyuhun brought tribute.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，敞史阿缽坐奉使失職，命笞之。

translations.literal: On day yimao, Chamberlain Abo, guilty of neglect in carrying out his mission, was ordered flogged.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day Chamberlain Abo, convicted of failing in his embassy, was ordered flogged.

sentences.zh: 閏月癸未，乙室大王坐賦調不均，以木劍背撻而釋之；

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on day guiwei, the Prince of Yishi, guilty of uneven tax levies, was beaten on the back with a wooden sword and released;
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on guiwei day, the Prince of Yishi, convicted of uneven tax levies, was beaten on the back with a wooden sword and released;

sentences.zh: 並罷南、北府民上供，及宰相、節度諸賦役非舊制者。

translations.literal: Also abolished the Northern and Southern Courts' people's upward deliveries, and taxes and corvée imposed on chancellors and military governors outside the old system.
translations.idiomatic: At the same time the court abolished the tribute levied on the people of the Northern and Southern Courts and the taxes and corvée imposed on chancellors and military governors beyond what the old system allowed.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，遣的烈賜晉烏古良馬。

translations.literal: On day yiyou, Dilie was dispatched to present fine Wugu horses to Jin.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day Dilie was sent to present fine Wugu horses to Jin.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以南王府二刺史貪蠹，各杖一百，仍系虞候帳，備射鬼箭，選群臣為民所愛者代之。

translations.literal: On day jichou, because two prefects of the Southern Prince's household were corrupt, each was flogged one hundred strokes, still tied to the guard account and made ready to shoot demon-arrows; ministers beloved by the people were chosen to replace them.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day two prefects of the Southern Prince's household, found corrupt, were each flogged one hundred strokes, bound to the guard account, and assigned to shoot demon-arrows; ministers favored by the people were chosen to take their places.

sentences.zh: 八月乙丑，晉遣使貢歲幣，奏輸戌、亥二歲金幣于燕京。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on day yichou, Jin sent envoys with annual tribute, reporting submission of gold and silk for the xu and hai years at Yanjing.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on yichou day, Jin sent envoys with the annual tribute, reporting payment of gold and silk for the xu and hai years at Yanjing.

sentences.zh: 九月甲戌，阻卜阿離底來貢。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on day jiaxu, Zubu Alidi came to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jiaxu day, Zubu Alidi brought tribute.

sentences.zh: 己卯，遣使使晉。

translations.literal: On day jimao, envoys were dispatched to Jin.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day envoys were sent to Jin.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁未，上以烏古部水草肥美，詔北、南院徙三石烈戶居之。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on day dingwei, because the Wugu tribe's pastures were rich and waters lush, an edict ordered the Northern and Southern Courts to move three shilie households to dwell there.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, in the tenth month on dingwei day, because the Wugu pastures were rich and the waters abundant, an edict ordered the Northern and Southern Courts to resettle three shilie households there.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁亥，鐵驪、敦煌並遣使來貢。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on day dinghai, the Iron Li and Dunhuang both dispatched envoys to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on dinghai day, the Iron Li and Dunhuang both sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚子，釣魚于土河。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on day gengzi, he went fishing on the Tu River.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on gengzi day, he fished on the Tu River.

sentences.zh: 甲子，回鶻使者傔人有以刃相擊者，詔付其使處之。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, among Uyghur envoys' attendants some struck one another with blades; an edict handed them to their envoy for punishment.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day some attendants among the Uyghur envoys drew blades on one another; an edict left their punishment to their own envoy.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月戊子，吳越王遣使來貢。

translations.literal: In the third year, in the first month of spring, on day wuzi, the King of Wuyue dispatched envoys to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, on wuzi day in the first month of spring, the King of Wuyue sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，人皇王妃來朝。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, the Renhuang King's consort came to court.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day the Renhuang King's consort came to court.

sentences.zh: 回鶻使乞觀諸國使朝見禮，從之。

translations.literal: Uyghur envoys asked to observe the various states' envoys' audience ceremony; it was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Uyghur envoys asked to witness the audience ceremony for foreign envoys; the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，遣陪謁阿缽使晉至生辰禮。

translations.literal: On day renchen, Attendant-of-Audience Abo was dispatched to Jin for the birthday rite.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day Attendant-of-Audience Abo was sent to Jin for the birthday ceremony.

sentences.zh: 晉以並、鎮、忻、代之吐谷渾來歸。

translations.literal: Jin presented the Tuyuhun of Bing, Zhen, Xin, and Dai who had come to submit.
translations.idiomatic: Jin presented the Tuyuhun of Bing, Zhen, Xin, and Dai who had submitted to them.

sentences.zh: 二月己亥，奚王勞骨寧率六節度使朝貢。

translations.literal: In the second month, on day jihai, Xi King Raoguning led six military governors in court tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jihai day, Xi King Raoguning led six military governors to court with tribute.

sentences.zh: 庚子，烏古遣使獻伏鹿國俘，賜其部夷離堇旗鼓以旌其功。

translations.literal: On day gengzi, Wugu sent envoys presenting captives from the Fulugu state; their yilijin was granted banners and drums to honor his achievement.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day Wugu sent envoys with captives taken in Fulugu; their yilijin was granted banners and drums in recognition of the feat.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，女直來貢。

translations.literal: On day renyin, the Jurchen came to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day the Jurchen brought tribute.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，墨離鶻末里使回鶻阿薩蘭還，賜對衣勞之。

translations.literal: On day xinhai, Molihumoli, envoy to the Uyghur Aslan, returned; facing robes were bestowed to reward him.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day Molihumoli, envoy to the Uyghur Aslan, returned; he was rewarded with facing robes.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，鴨淥江女直遣使來覲。

translations.literal: On day yimao, the Yalu River Jurchen dispatched envoys to attend court.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day the Yalu River Jurchen sent envoys to attend court.

sentences.zh: 三月戊辰，遣使使晉，報幸南京。

translations.literal: In the third month, on day wuchen, envoys were dispatched to Jin reporting the tour to the Southern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on wuchen day, envoys were sent to Jin to announce his tour to the Southern Capital.

sentences.zh: 己巳，如南京。

translations.literal: On day jisi, he went to the Southern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day he went to the Southern Capital.

sentences.zh: 辛未，命惕隱耶律涅離骨德率萬騎先驅。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, tixin Yelü Nieligude was ordered to lead ten thousand horsemen as vanguard.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day tixin Yelü Nieligude was ordered to lead ten thousand horsemen as vanguard.

sentences.zh: 壬申，次石嶺，以奚王勞骨寧、監軍寅你已朝謁不時，切責之。

translations.literal: On day renshen, he halted at Shiling; because Xi King Raoguning and Military Commissioner Yinniyi had not come promptly to audience, they were sharply rebuked.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day he halted at Shiling; Xi King Raoguning and Military Commissioner Yinniyi, having failed to come promptly to audience, were sharply rebuked.

sentences.zh: 丙子，魯不姑上党項俘獲數。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, Lubugu reported the count of Tangut captives taken.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day Lubugu reported the number of Tangut captives taken.

sentences.zh: 癸未，獵水門，獲白鹿。

translations.literal: On day guiwei, he hunted at Shuimen and captured a white deer.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day he hunted at Shuimen and took a white deer.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，詔扈從擾民者從軍律。

translations.literal: On day gengyin, an edict directed that retainers who harassed the people were to be punished under military law.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day an edict declared that retainers who harassed the people would be punished under military law.

sentences.zh: 甲午，幸薊州。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, he visited Ji Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day he visited Ji Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 乙未，晉及南唐各遣使來覲。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, Jin and Southern Tang each dispatched envoys to attend court.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day Jin and Southern Tang each sent envoys to attend court.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚子，至燕，備法駕，入自拱辰門，御元和殿，行入閤禮。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on day gengzi, he reached Yan, readied the full imperial retinue, entered through Gongchen Gate, took his seat in Yuanhe Hall, and performed the entering-the-palace-gate rite.
translations.idiomatic: That summer, in the fourth month on gengzi day, he reached Yan, marshaled the full imperial procession, entered through Gongchen Gate, took his seat in Yuanhe Hall, and performed the entering-the-palace-gate rite.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，遣人使晉。

translations.literal: On day renyin, envoys were dispatched to Jin.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day envoys were sent to Jin.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，幸留守趙延壽別墅。

translations.literal: On day yisi, he visited the detached villa of Garrison Commander Zhao Yanshou.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day he visited the country villa of Garrison Commander Zhao Yanshou.

sentences.zh: 丙午，晉遣宣徽使楊端、王眺等來問起居。

translations.literal: On day bingwu, Jin dispatched Xuanhui Commissioners Yang Duan, Wang Tiao, and others to inquire after his health.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day Jin sent Xuanhui Commissioners Yang Duan, Wang Tiao, and others to inquire after his health.

sentences.zh: 壬子，御便殿，宴晉及諸國使。

translations.literal: On day renzi, he took his seat in the informal hall and feasted the Jin envoys and envoys of the various states.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day he held court in the informal hall and feasted the Jin envoys and envoys from the tributary states.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，晉遣使進茶藥。

translations.literal: On day bingchen, Jin sent envoys presenting tea and medicines.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day Jin sent envoys with tea and medicines.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，御昭慶殿，宴南京群臣。

translations.literal: On day renxu, he took his seat in Zhaoging Hall and feasted the Southern Capital ministers.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day he sat in Zhaoging Hall and feasted the ministers of the Southern Capital.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，晉遣使賀端午，以所進節物賜群臣。

translations.literal: On day guihai, Jin sent envoys congratulating on the Dragon Boat Festival; the festival goods presented were bestowed on the ministers.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day Jin sent envoys to congratulate him on the Dragon Boat Festival, and the festival gifts they brought were distributed among the ministers.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，南唐進白龜。

translations.literal: On day yichou, Southern Tang presented a white tortoise.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day Southern Tang presented a white tortoise.

sentences.zh: 五月庚午，以端午宴群臣及諸國使，命回鶻、敦煌二使作本俗舞，俾諸使觀之。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on gengwu day, he held a Dragon Boat Festival feast for the assembled ministers and envoys of the various states, ordering the Uyghur and Dunhuang envoys to perform their native dances for the other envoys to watch.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on gengwu day, he feasted his ministers and the envoys of every tributary state for the Dragon Boat Festival and had the Uyghur and Dunhuang ambassadors dance in their own styles so the rest might see them.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，晉遣使進弓矢。

translations.literal: On gengchen day, Jin sent envoys presenting bows and arrows.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day Jin sent envoys with bows and arrows as tribute.

sentences.zh: 甲申，遣皇子天德及檢校司徒邸用和使晉。

translations.literal: On jiashen day, he dispatched the prince Tiande and Acting Director of the Department of State Affairs Di Yonghe as envoys to Jin.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day he sent Prince Tiande and Acting Director of the Department of State Affairs Di Yonghe as envoys to Jin.

sentences.zh: 戊子，閱騎兵于南郊。

translations.literal: On wuzi day, he reviewed cavalry in the southern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day he reviewed the cavalry in the southern suburb.

sentences.zh: 六月乙未朔，東京宰相耶律羽之言渤海相大素賢不法，詔僚佐部民舉有才德者代之。

translations.literal: On the yiwei new moon of the sixth month, Eastern Capital Chancellor Yelü Yuzhi reported that Bohai Chancellor Da Suxian was unlawful; an edict ordered aides and the populace to recommend a talented and virtuous person to replace him.
translations.idiomatic: At the yiwei new moon of the sixth month, Eastern Capital Chancellor Yelü Yuzhi reported that Bohai Chancellor Da Suxian had broken the law; an edict called on his staff and the people to nominate a worthy successor.

sentences.zh: 丙申，閱步卒于南郊。

translations.literal: On bingshen day, he reviewed infantry in the southern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day he reviewed the infantry in the southern suburb.

sentences.zh: 庚子，晉及轄剌骨只遣使來見。

translations.literal: On gengzi day, Jin and Kala Guzhi sent envoys to pay court.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day envoys from Jin and Kala Guzhi came to court.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，駕發燕京，命中書令蕭僧隱部諸道軍于長坐營。

translations.literal: On renyin day, the imperial carriage departed Yanjing; Zhongshu Ling Xiao Sengyin was ordered to muster armies from all circuits at Changzuo Camp.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day the court left Yanjing; Zhongshu Ling Xiao Sengyin was ordered to assemble the armies of every circuit at Changzuo Camp.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，次奉聖州。

translations.literal: On guichou day, the court halted at Fengsheng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day the imperial train halted at Fengsheng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，勞軍士。

translations.literal: On jiayin day, he rewarded the soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day he rewarded the troops.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己巳，獵猾底烈山。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on jisi day, he hunted at Huadilie Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn, in the seventh month, on jisi day, he hunted at Huadilie Mountain.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，朝于皇太后。

translations.literal: On guiyou day, he attended court with the Empress Dowager.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day he attended the Empress Dowager at court.

sentences.zh: 丙子，從皇太后視人皇王妃疾。

translations.literal: On bingzi day, he accompanied the Empress Dowager to visit the Human Sovereign King's consort, who was ill.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day he went with the Empress Dowager to visit the Human Sovereign King's consort, who lay ill.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，人皇王妃蕭氏薨。

translations.literal: On wuyin day, the Human Sovereign King's consort, née Xiao, died.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day the Human Sovereign King's consort, née Xiao, died.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以安重榮據鎮州叛晉，詔征南將軍柳嚴邊備。

translations.literal: On jimao day, because An Chongrong held Zhen Prefecture and rebelled against Jin, an edict ordered the Southern Campaign General Liu Yan to prepare border defenses.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, with An Chongrong holding Zhen Prefecture in revolt against Jin, an edict ordered Southern Campaign General Liu Yan to strengthen the frontier.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，徙人皇王行宮于其妃薨所。

translations.literal: On bingxu day, the Human Sovereign King's traveling palace was moved to the place where his consort died.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day the Human Sovereign King's traveling palace was moved to the place where his consort had died.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，晉遣使請行南郊禮，許之。

translations.literal: On xinmao day, Jin sent envoys requesting permission to perform the Southern Suburb rite; permission was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day Jin sent envoys asking leave to sacrifice at the Southern Suburb; leave was granted.

sentences.zh: 八月己亥，詔東丹吏民為其王倍妃蕭氏服。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on jihai day, an edict ordered Eastern Dan officials and people to observe mourning for their king Bei's consort, née Xiao.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jihai day, an edict ordered the officials and people of Eastern Dan to mourn their king Bei's consort, née Xiao.

sentences.zh: 庚子，阻卜來貢。

translations.literal: On gengzi day, Tlübu came with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day Tlübu brought tribute.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，遣使南唐。

translations.literal: On renyin day, envoys were dispatched to Southern Tang.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day envoys were sent to Southern Tang.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，阻卜、黑車子室韋、賃烈等國來貢。

translations.literal: On yisi day, Tlübu, the Black Cart Shiwei, Zhenlie, and other states came with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day Tlübu, the Black Cart Shiwei, Zhenlie, and other states brought tribute.

sentences.zh: 南唐遣使求青氈帳，賜之。

translations.literal: Southern Tang sent envoys requesting blue felt tents; they were granted.
translations.idiomatic: Southern Tang sent envoys asking for blue felt tents, and they were granted.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以安端私城為白川州。

translations.literal: On wushen day, Anduan's private city was made Baichuan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day Anduan's private city was established as Baichuan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，鼻骨德使乞賜爵，以其國相授之。

translations.literal: On xinhai day, the envoys from Bigude requested the bestowal of titles; they were given the rank of chancellor of their state.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day Bigude's envoys asked for titles to be conferred, and they were granted the rank of chancellor of their state.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，阻卜來貢。

translations.literal: On jiayin day, Tlübu came with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day Tlübu brought tribute again.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，置白川州官屬。

translations.literal: On yimao day, the official staff of Baichuan Prefecture was established.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day the official staff of Baichuan Prefecture was appointed.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，詔以于諧里河、臚朐河之近地，給賜南院歐堇突呂、乙斯勃、北院溫納何剌、三石烈人為農田。

translations.literal: On bingchen day, an edict granted land near the Yuhelili River and the Luchqu River as farmland to the Southern Court's Ojintulü, Yisibo, the Northern Court's Wennahala, and the Three Shilie clans.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day an edict granted land near the Yuhelili and Luchqu rivers as farmland to the Southern Court's Ojintulü and Yisibo, the Northern Court's Wennahala, and the Three Shilie clans.

sentences.zh: 九月庚午，侍中崔窮古言：「晉主聞陛下數遊獵，意請節之。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on gengwu day, Palace Attendant Cui Qionggu said: "The Jin ruler has heard that Your Majesty hunts frequently and wishes to ask you to restrain yourself.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on gengwu day, Palace Attendant Cui Qionggu said, "The Jin ruler has heard that Your Majesty hunts often and wishes to ask you to show restraint.

sentences.zh: 」上曰：「朕之畋獵，非徒從樂，所以練習武事也。

translations.literal: " The emperor said: "My hunting is not merely for pleasure; it is to drill in military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor replied, "My hunting is not mere diversion; it is training for war.

sentences.zh: 」乃詔諭之。

translations.literal: " An edict was issued to inform Jin accordingly.
translations.idiomatic: " An edict was then issued to explain this to Jin.

sentences.zh: 壬午，邊將奏破吐谷渾，擒其長；

translations.literal: On renwu day, border commanders reported defeating the Tuyuhun and capturing their chieftain;
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day frontier commanders reported a victory over the Tuyuhun and the capture of their chieftain;

sentences.zh: 詔止誅其首惡及其丁壯，餘並釋之。

translations.literal: an edict ordered that only the ringleaders and able-bodied men be put to death; the rest were all released.
translations.idiomatic: an edict ordered that only the ringleaders and fighting men be executed; all the rest were released.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，晉遣使貢名馬。

translations.literal: On bingxu day, Jin sent envoys presenting fine horses.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day Jin sent envoys with fine horses as tribute.

sentences.zh: 戊子，女直及吳越王遣使來貢。

translations.literal: On wuzi day, the Jurchen and the King of Wuyue sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day the Jurchen and the King of Wuyue sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛丑，遣克郎使吳越，略姑使南唐。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on xinchou day, Kelang was dispatched as envoy to Wuyue and Lüegu as envoy to Southern Tang.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, in the tenth month, on xinchou day, Kelang was sent to Wuyue and Lüegu to Southern Tang.

sentences.zh: 庚申，晉遣使貢布，及請親祠南嶽，從之。

translations.literal: On gengshen day, Jin sent envoys presenting cloth and requesting permission to perform sacrifice personally at Mount Heng; permission was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day Jin sent envoys with cloth and asked leave to sacrifice in person at Mount Heng; leave was granted.

sentences.zh: 十一月己巳，南唐遣使奉蠟丸書言晉密事。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on jisi day, Southern Tang sent envoys bearing sealed wax-ball dispatches reporting Jin's secret affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on jisi day, Southern Tang sent envoys with sealed wax-ball dispatches reporting Jin's secret affairs.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，詔有司教民播種紡績。

translations.literal: On dingchou day, an edict ordered the relevant offices to teach the people sowing and spinning.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day an edict ordered the relevant offices to teach the people sowing and weaving.

sentences.zh: 除姊亡妹續之法。

translations.literal: The law whereby, on the death of an elder sister, a younger sister could succeed her in marriage was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The law allowing a younger sister to succeed an elder sister in marriage after the elder's death was abolished.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬辰朔，率百僚謁太祖行宮。

translations.literal: On the renchen new moon of the twelfth month, he led the hundred officials to pay homage at the Taizu traveling palace.
translations.idiomatic: At the renchen new moon of the twelfth month he led the hundred officials to pay homage at the Taizu traveling palace.

sentences.zh: 甲午，燔柴，禮畢，祠于神帳。

translations.literal: On jiawu day, after the firewood-burning rite was completed, sacrifice was performed at the spirit tent.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day, when the burnt-offering rite was finished, sacrifice was performed at the spirit tent.

sentences.zh: 丙申，遣使使晉。

translations.literal: On bingshen day, envoys were dispatched to Jin.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day envoys were sent to Jin.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，詔契丹人授漢官者從漢儀，聽與漢人婚姻。

translations.literal: On bingchen day, an edict ordered that Khitan given Han offices follow Han ritual and were permitted to marry Han people.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day an edict ordered Khitan who received Han offices to follow Han ritual and permitted them to marry Han people.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，詔燕京皇城西南堞建涼殿。

translations.literal: On dingsi day, an edict ordered a Cool Hall built on the southwest battlement of the Yanjing Imperial City.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day an edict ordered a Cool Hall built on the southwest wall of the Yanjing Imperial City.

sentences.zh: 是冬，駐蹕于傘淀。

translations.literal: That winter, the court encamped at San Dian.
translations.idiomatic: That winter the court encamped at San Dian.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月壬戌，以乙室、品卑、突軌三部鰥寡不能自存者，官為之配。

translations.literal: In the spring of the fourth year, on the first month's renxu day, widows and widowers of the Yishi, Pinbei, and Tugui Three Departments who could not support themselves were matched in marriage by the state.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the fourth year, on renxu day in the first month, widows and widowers of the Yishi, Pinbei, and Tugui Three Departments who could not support themselves were given spouses at state expense.

sentences.zh: 丙子，南唐遣使來貢。

translations.literal: On bingzi day, Southern Tang sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day Southern Tang sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，涅剌、烏隗部獻党項俘獲數。

translations.literal: On gengchen day, the Niela and Wugui tribes presented captives taken from the Tangut campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day the Niela and Wugui tribes presented captives from the Tangut campaign.

sentences.zh: 己丑，詔定征党項功。

translations.literal: On jichou day, an edict fixed rewards for the Tangut campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day an edict fixed rewards for the campaign against the Tangut.

sentences.zh: 二月丙申，皇太子獲白獐。

translations.literal: In the second month, on bingshen day, the Crown Prince obtained a white roe deer.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on bingshen day, the Crown Prince took a white roe deer.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，晉遣使進香藥。

translations.literal: On jiachen day, Jin sent envoys presenting fragrant medicines.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day Jin sent envoys with fragrant medicines.

sentences.zh: 丙子，鐵驪來貢。

translations.literal: On bingzi day, Tieli came with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day Tieli brought tribute.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，詔有司編《始祖奇首可汗事跡》。

translations.literal: On dingsi day, an edict ordered the relevant offices to compile a Record of the Deeds of the Founding Ancestor Qishou Khan.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day an edict ordered the relevant offices to compile a Record of the Deeds of the Founding Ancestor Qishou Khan.

sentences.zh: 己未，晉遣楊彥詢來貢。

translations.literal: On jiwei day, Jin dispatched Yang Yancun with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day Jin dispatched Yang Yancun with tribute.

sentences.zh: 且言鎮州安重榮跋扈狀，遂留不遣。

translations.literal: He also reported An Chongrong's insubordination at Zhen Prefecture, and Yang Yancun was detained and not sent back.
translations.idiomatic: He also reported An Chongrong's arrogance at Zhen Prefecture, and Yang Yancun was detained and not sent home.

sentences.zh: 是月，晉鎮州安重榮執遼使者拽剌。

translations.literal: That month, An Chongrong of Zhen Prefecture in Jin seized the Liao envoy Zhuaila.
translations.idiomatic: That month An Chongrong of Zhen Prefecture in Jin seized the Liao envoy Zhuaila.

sentences.zh: 三月，特授回鶻使闊里于越，並賜旌旗、弓劍、衣馬，餘賜有差。

translations.literal: In the third month, the Uyghur envoy Kol Yuyue was specially granted office, along with banners, flags, bow and sword, clothing and horses; other gifts were bestowed in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month the Uyghur envoy Kol Yuyue was specially appointed to office and given banners, flags, bow and sword, clothing and horses; other gifts were bestowed in varying measure.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，晉以許祀南郊，遣使來謝，進黃金十鎰。

translations.literal: On guiyou day, Jin, having been permitted to sacrifice at the Southern Suburb, sent envoys to offer thanks and presented ten yi of gold.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day Jin, having been permitted to sacrifice at the Southern Suburb, sent envoys to give thanks and presented ten yi of gold.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己卯，晉遣使進櫻桃。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on jimao day, Jin sent envoys presenting cherries.
translations.idiomatic: That summer, in the fourth month, on jimao day, Jin sent envoys with cherries.

sentences.zh: 五月庚辰，吐谷渾夷離堇蘇等叛入晉。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on gengchen day, the Tuyuhun yilijin Su and others rebelled and fled into Jin territory.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on gengchen day, the Tuyuhun yilijin Su and others rebelled and fled into Jin.

sentences.zh: 遣牒蠟往諭晉及太原守臣。

translations.literal: Dieliao was dispatched with sealed dispatches to instruct Jin and the garrison commanders of Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Dieliao was sent with sealed dispatches to instruct Jin and the garrison commanders at Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 六月辛卯，振武軍節度副使趙崇逐其節度使耶律畫里，以朔州叛，附晉。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on xinmao day, Zhenwu Army Deputy Military Governor Zhao Chong drove out his military governor Yelü Huali and rebelled with Shuozhou, aligning with Jin.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on xinmao day, Zhenwu Army Deputy Military Governor Zhao Chong drove out his military governor Yelü Huali and rebelled with Shuozhou, submitting to Jin.

sentences.zh: 丙午，命宣徽使褭古只赴朔州，以兵圍其城，有晉使至，請開壁，即勿聽，驛送闕下。

translations.literal: On bingwu day, the court ordered Commissioner of the Palace Domestic Service Naogu Zhi to Shuozhou with troops to besiege the city; when a Jin envoy arrived and requested that the gates be opened, he was not allowed and was sent under escort to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day the court ordered Commissioner of the Palace Domestic Service Naogu Zhi to Shuozhou with troops to besiege the city; when a Jin envoy arrived and asked that the gates be opened, he was refused and sent under escort to the capital.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸亥，南唐遣使奉蠟丸書。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on guihai day, Southern Tang sent envoys bearing sealed wax-ball dispatches.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn, in the seventh month, on guihai day, Southern Tang sent envoys with sealed wax-ball dispatches.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，褭古只奏請遣使至朔令降，守者猶堅壁弗納。

translations.literal: On bingyin day, Naogu Zhi memorialized requesting that an envoy be sent to Shuozhou to summon surrender; the defenders still held the walls and would not admit him.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day Naogu Zhi memorialized asking that an envoy be sent to Shuozhou to demand surrender; the defenders still held the walls and would not let him in.

sentences.zh: 且言晉有貢物。

translations.literal: He also reported that Jin had tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: He also reported that Jin had sent tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 命即以所貢物賜攻城將校。

translations.literal: An order was issued to bestow the tribute goods immediately upon the siege commanders.
translations.idiomatic: An order was issued to give the tribute goods at once to the siege commanders.

sentences.zh: 己巳，有司奏神纛車有蜂巢成蜜，史占之，吉。

translations.literal: On jisi day, the relevant offices reported that a beehive on the spirit-banner carriage had produced honey; the diviner's reading was auspicious.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day the relevant offices reported that a beehive on the spirit-banner carriage had yielded honey; the diviner's reading was auspicious.

sentences.zh: 壬申，晉遣使進水晶硯。

translations.literal: On renshen day, Jin sent envoys presenting crystal inkstones.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day Jin sent envoys with crystal inkstones.

sentences.zh: 八月癸巳，南唐奉蠟丸書。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on guisi day, Southern Tang sent wax-ball dispatches.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on guisi day, Southern Tang sent wax-ball dispatches.

sentences.zh: 庚子，晉遣使進犀弓、竹矢。

translations.literal: On gengzi day, Jin sent envoys presenting rhinoceros-horn bows and bamboo arrows.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day Jin sent envoys with rhinoceros-horn bows and bamboo arrows.

sentences.zh: 吳越王遣使奉蠟丸書。

translations.literal: The King of Wuyue sent envoys bearing wax-ball dispatches.
translations.idiomatic: The King of Wuyue sent envoys with wax-ball dispatches.

sentences.zh: 九月壬申，有星孛于晉分。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on renshen day, a comet appeared in the Jin asterism.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on renshen day, a comet appeared in the Jin asterism.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，幸歸化州。

translations.literal: On dingchou day, he proceeded to Guihua Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day he traveled to Guihua Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛丑，有司奏燕、薊大熟。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on xinchou day, the relevant offices reported a great harvest in Yan and Ji.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, in the tenth month, on xinchou day, the relevant offices reported a great harvest in Yan and Ji.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，吳越王遣使來貢。

translations.literal: On guimao day, the King of Wuyue sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day the King of Wuyue sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙寅，晉以討安重榮來告。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on bingyin day, Jin came to report that it was campaigning against An Chongrong.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on bingyin day, Jin sent word that it was campaigning against An Chongrong.

sentences.zh: 庚午，吐谷渾請降，遣使撫諭。

translations.literal: On gengwu day, the Tuyuhun requested surrender; envoys were dispatched to reassure them.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day the Tuyuhun asked to submit; envoys were sent to reassure them.

sentences.zh: 阻卜來貢，以其物賜左右。

translations.literal: Tlübu came with tribute; his gifts were bestowed on attendants of the court.
translations.idiomatic: Tlübu brought tribute, and his gifts were given to the emperor's attendants.

sentences.zh: 丙子，鴨淥江女直來貢。

translations.literal: On bingzi day, the Jurchen of the Yalu River came with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day the Jurchen of the Yalu River brought tribute.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以永寧、天授二節及正旦、重午、冬至、臘並受賀，著令。

translations.literal: On renwu day, an edict established that the Yongning and Tianshou festivals, together with New Year's Day, the Double Fifth, the Winter Solstice, and the la sacrifice day, were all occasions for receiving congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day an edict established that the Yongning and Tianshou festivals, together with New Year's Day, the Double Fifth, the Winter Solstice, and the la sacrifice day, were all occasions for receiving congratulations.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊子，晉遣使來告山南節度使安從進反。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on wuzi day, Jin sent envoys reporting that Shannan Military Governor An Congjin had rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on wuzi day, Jin sent envoys reporting that Shannan Military Governor An Congjin had rebelled.

sentences.zh: 詔以便宜討之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that he be subjugated as circumstances permitted.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered that he be subdued as circumstances allowed.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，南唐遣使奉蠟丸書。

translations.literal: On gengyin day, Southern Tang sent envoys bearing wax-ball dispatches.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day Southern Tang sent envoys with wax-ball dispatches.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，晉遣王升鸞來貢。

translations.literal: On wuxu day, Jin dispatched Wang Shengluan with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day Jin dispatched Wang Shengluan with tribute.

sentences.zh: 戊申，晉以敗安重榮來告，遂遣楊彥詢歸。

translations.literal: On wushen day, Jin reported the defeat of An Chongrong, and Yang Yancun was then sent back.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day Jin reported the defeat of An Chongrong, and Yang Yancun was then sent home.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，晉遣使乞罷戍兵，詔惕隱朔古班師。

translations.literal: On xinhai day, Jin sent envoys requesting the withdrawal of garrison troops; an edict ordered Tiyi Shuogu to withdraw his army.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day Jin sent envoys asking that the garrison troops be withdrawn; an edict ordered Tiyi Shuogu to withdraw his army.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，攻拔朔州，遣控鶴指揮使諧里勞軍。

translations.literal: On jiayin day, Shuozhou was taken by assault; Commissioner of the Crane Controllers Heli was dispatched to reward the troops.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day Shuozhou was taken by storm; Commissioner of the Crane Controllers Heli was sent to reward the troops.

sentences.zh: 時褭古只戰歿城下，上怒，命誅城中丁壯，仍以叛民上戶三十為褭古只部曲。

translations.literal: At the time Naogu Zhi had fallen in battle below the walls; the emperor was furious and ordered the able-bodied men in the city put to death, and thirty leading households among the rebels were assigned as Naogu Zhi's retainers.
translations.idiomatic: Naogu Zhi had by then fallen in battle beneath the walls; the emperor was furious and ordered the able-bodied men of the city put to death, and thirty leading rebel households were assigned as Naogu Zhi's retainers.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月丙辰朔，上在歸化州，御行殿受群臣朝。

translations.literal: In the spring of the fifth year, on the bingchen new moon of the first month, the emperor was at Guihua Prefecture; he received the ministers' obeisance from the traveling hall.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the fifth year, at the bingchen new moon of the first month, the emperor was at Guihua Prefecture and received the ministers' obeisance from the traveling hall.

sentences.zh: 以諸道貢物進太后及賜宗室百僚。

translations.literal: Tribute goods from all circuits were presented to the Empress Dowager and bestowed on the imperial clan and the hundred officials.
translations.idiomatic: Tribute goods from every circuit were presented to the Empress Dowager and bestowed on the imperial clan and the hundred officials.

sentences.zh: 戊午，詔求直言，北王府郎君耶律海思應詔，召對稱旨，特授宣徽使。

translations.literal: On wuwu day, an edict solicited frank counsel; Yelü Haisi, a gentleman of the Northern Prince's household, answered the summons; summoned for audience, his replies pleased the emperor, and he was specially appointed Commissioner of the Palace Domestic Service.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day an edict called for frank counsel; Yelü Haisi, a gentleman of the Northern Prince's household, answered the summons, and when summoned to audience his replies pleased the emperor; he was specially appointed Commissioner of the Palace Domestic Service.

sentences.zh: 詔政事令僧隱等以契丹戶分屯南邊。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Chancellor Sengyin and others to distribute Khitan households in garrison settlements along the southern frontier.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Chancellor Sengyin and others to distribute Khitan households in garrison settlements along the southern frontier.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，晉函安重榮首來獻。

translations.literal: On wuchen day, Jin sent An Chongrong's head in a casket as tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day Jin sent An Chongrong's head in a casket as tribute.

sentences.zh: 上數欲親討重榮，至是乃止。

translations.literal: The emperor had many times wished to take the field personally against Chongrong; only now did he desist.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor had many times wished to take the field personally against Chongrong; only now did he give up the plan.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，遣使使晉。

translations.literal: On guiyou day, envoys were dispatched to Jin.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day envoys were sent to Jin.

sentences.zh: 是月，晉以朔州平，遣使來賀，遂遣客省使耶律化哥使晉，並致生辰禮。

translations.literal: That month, Jin, with Shuozhou pacified, sent envoys to offer congratulations; the court then dispatched Guest Reception Commissioner Yelü Huage as envoy to Jin and also to present birthday gifts.
translations.idiomatic: That month, with Shuozhou pacified, Jin sent envoys to offer congratulations; the court then dispatched Guest Reception Commissioner Yelü Huage to Jin and also to present birthday gifts.

sentences.zh: 二月壬辰，上將南幸，以諸路有未平者，召太子及群臣議，皆曰：「今襄、鎮、朔三州雖已平，然吐谷渾為安重榮所誘，猶未歸命，宜發兵討之，以警諸部。

translations.literal: In the second month, on renchen day, as the emperor was about to make a southern progress, with several circuits still unsettled, he summoned the Crown Prince and the ministers for discussion; all said: "Though Xiang, Zhen, and Shuo have been pacified, the Tuyuhun, seduced by An Chongrong, have not yet submitted; troops should be sent to chastise them and warn the other tribes.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on renchen day, as the emperor was about to travel south, with several circuits still unsettled, he summoned the Crown Prince and his ministers to discuss the matter; all said, "Though Xiang, Zhen, and Shuo are pacified, the Tuyuhun, led astray by An Chongrong, have not yet submitted; troops should be sent to chastise them and warn the other tribes.

sentences.zh: 」上曰：「正與朕合。

translations.literal: " The emperor said: "That is exactly my own view.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor said, "That is exactly my own view.

sentences.zh: 」遂詔以明王隈恩代于越信恩為西南路招討使以討之，且諭明王宜先練習邊事，而後之官。

translations.literal: " An edict thereupon appointed Prince Ming Weien to replace Yuyue Xinen as Southwest Route Campaign Commissioner to attack them, and the Prince of Ming was instructed to drill first in border affairs before taking up the post.
translations.idiomatic: " An edict thereupon appointed Prince Ming Weien to replace Yuyue Xinen as Southwest Route Campaign Commissioner to attack them, and the Prince of Ming was told to drill first in frontier affairs before taking up the post.

sentences.zh: 甲午，如南京。

translations.literal: On day jiawu, he went to Nanjing.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day he traveled to Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 遣使使晉索吐谷渾叛者。

translations.literal: Envoys were dispatched to Jin to demand the Tuyuhun rebels.
translations.idiomatic: He sent envoys to Jin demanding the surrender of the Tuyuhun rebels.

sentences.zh: 乙未，鼻骨德來貢。

translations.literal: On day yiwei, the Biegude came to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day the Biegude brought tribute.

sentences.zh: 三月乙卯朔，晉遣齊州防禦使宋暉業、翰林茶酒使張言來問起居。

translations.literal: On the yimao new moon of the third month, Jin sent Qi Prefecture defense commissioner Song Huiye and Hanlin tea-and-wine commissioner Zhang Yan to inquire after his health.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao new moon of the third month Jin sent Qi Prefecture defense commissioner Song Huiye and Hanlin tea-and-wine commissioner Zhang Yan to inquire after the Emperor's health.

sentences.zh: 閏月，駐蹕陽門。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, he halted at Yang Gate.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month he encamped at Yang Gate.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲寅朔，鐵驪來貢，以其物分賜群臣。

translations.literal: On the jiayin new moon of the fourth month of summer, the Iron Li came to pay tribute; their goods were divided and bestowed on the ministers.
translations.idiomatic: That summer, on the jiayin new moon of the fourth month, the Iron Li brought tribute, and their gifts were divided among the ministers.

sentences.zh: 丙子，晉遣使進射柳鞍馬。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, Jin sent envoys presenting willow-shoot archery saddles and horses.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day Jin sent envoys bearing saddles and horses for willow-shoot archery.

sentences.zh: 五月五日戊子，禁屠宰。

translations.literal: On the fifth day of the fifth month, day wuzi, slaughter was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On the Double Fifth, wuzi day, slaughter was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 六月癸丑朔，晉齊王重貴遣使來貢。

translations.literal: On the guichou new moon of the sixth month, Jin's Prince of Qi, Chonggui, sent envoys to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou new moon of the sixth month Jin's Prince of Qi, Chonggui, sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，徒睹古、素撒來貢。

translations.literal: On day dingsi, Tudu and Susa came to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day Tudu and Susa came with tribute.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，晉主敬瑭殂，子重貴立。

translations.literal: On day yichou, Jin's emperor Jingtang died; his son Chonggui succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day Jin's emperor Jingtang died, and his son Chonggui took the throne.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，晉遣使告哀，輟朝七日。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, Jin sent envoys announcing mourning; court was suspended for seven days.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day Jin sent envoys announcing the mourning; court levees were suspended for seven days.

sentences.zh: 庚午，遣使往晉弔祭。

translations.literal: On day gengwu, envoys were dispatched to Jin to offer condolences and sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day envoys were sent to Jin to offer condolences and sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，聞皇太后不豫，上馳入侍，湯藥必親嘗。

translations.literal: On day dingchou, hearing the Grand Empress Dowager was unwell, the Emperor hurried in to attend her; every medicine he personally tasted.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day, hearing the Grand Empress Dowager was ill, the Emperor rushed in to wait on her and personally tasted every dose of medicine.

sentences.zh: 仍告太祖廟，幸菩薩堂，飯僧五萬人。

translations.literal: He also reported at Emperor Taizu's temple, visited the Bodhisattva Hall, and fed fifty thousand monks.
translations.idiomatic: He also reported at Emperor Taizu's temple, visited the Bodhisattva Hall, and fed fifty thousand monks.

sentences.zh: 七月乃愈。

translations.literal: In the seventh month she recovered.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month she recovered.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚寅，晉遣金吾衛大將軍梁言、判四方館事朱崇節來謝，書稱孫，不稱臣，遣客省使喬榮讓之。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on day gengyin, Jin sent Golden Wield Guard senior general Liang Yan and Four Quarters Bureau commissioner Zhu Chongjie to express thanks; the letter styled him grandson but not subject; Guest Reception commissioner Qiao Rong was sent to rebuke them.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh autumn month, on gengyin day, Jin sent Golden Wield Guard senior general Liang Yan and Four Quarters Bureau commissioner Zhu Chongjie to offer thanks; their letter styled the Emperor as grandson but not as subject, and Guest Reception commissioner Qiao Rong was dispatched to rebuke them.

sentences.zh: 景延廣答曰：「先帝則聖朝所立，今主則我國自冊。

translations.literal: Jing Yanguang replied: "The former emperor was installed by your holy court; the present ruler was invested by our own state.
translations.idiomatic: Jing Yanguang answered, "The former emperor was enthroned by your holy court; the present ruler was invested by our own state.

sentences.zh: 為鄰為孫則可，奉表稱臣則不可。

translations.literal: As neighbor and as grandson is acceptable; submitting memorials calling oneself subject is not.
translations.idiomatic: As neighbor and as grandson is acceptable; submitting memorials that call oneself subject is not."

sentences.zh: 」榮還，具奏之，上始有南伐之意。

translations.literal: " Qiao Rong returned and reported in full; the Emperor first conceived the intention of a southern campaign.
translations.idiomatic: Qiao Rong returned and reported everything; the Emperor first conceived the plan of a southern campaign.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，阻卜、鼻骨德、烏古來貢。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, the Zubu, Biegude, and Wugu came to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day the Zubu, Biegude, and Wugu all brought tribute.

sentences.zh: 將軍闥德里、蒲骨等率降將轄德至闕，並獻所獲。

translations.literal: Generals Tadali, Pugu, and others led the surrendered general Xiade to court and presented their captures.
translations.idiomatic: Generals Tadali, Pugu, and others led the surrendered general Xiade to court and presented what they had taken.

sentences.zh: 丁未，晉遣使以祖母哀來告。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, Jin sent envoys announcing mourning for their grand empress dowager.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day Jin sent envoys announcing mourning for their grand empress dowager.

sentences.zh: 八月辛酉，女直、阻卜、烏古各貢方物。

translations.literal: On day xinyou in the eighth month, the Jurchen, Zubu, and Wugu each presented local products.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day in the eighth month the Jurchen, Zubu, and Wugu each presented local products.

sentences.zh: 甲子，晉復襄州。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, Jin recovered Xiang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day Jin recovered Xiang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，詔河東節度使劉知遠送叛臣烏古指揮使由燕京赴闕。

translations.literal: On day wuchen, an edict ordered Hedong military governor Liu Zhiyuan to escort the rebel Wugu commander to court via Yanjing.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day an edict ordered Hedong military governor Liu Zhiyuan to send the rebel Wugu commander to court by way of Yanjing.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，遣天城軍節度使蕭拜石弔祭于晉。

translations.literal: On day guiyou, Tiancheng Army military governor Xiao Baishi was dispatched to Jin to offer condolences and sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day Tiancheng Army military governor Xiao Baishi was sent to Jin to offer condolences and sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 九月壬辰，遣使賀晉帝嗣位。

translations.literal: On day renchen in the ninth month, envoys were dispatched to congratulate the Jin emperor on his succession.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day in the ninth month envoys were dispatched to congratulate the Jin emperor on his succession.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己巳，征諸道兵。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on day jisi, troops were levied from all circuits.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, in the tenth month, on jisi day, troops were levied from every circuit.

sentences.zh: 遣將軍密骨德伐党項。

translations.literal: General Migude was dispatched to campaign against the Tangut.
translations.idiomatic: General Migude was dispatched to campaign against the Tangut.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙未，武定軍奏松生棗。

translations.literal: On day yiwei in the eleventh month, Wuding Army reported pines bearing dates.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day in the eleventh month Wuding Army reported pines bearing dates.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸亥，晉遣使來謝。

translations.literal: On day guihai in the twelfth month, Jin sent envoys to express thanks.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day in the twelfth month Jin sent envoys to express thanks.

sentences.zh: 是冬，駐蹕赤城。

translations.literal: That winter, he halted at Chicheng.
translations.idiomatic: That winter he encamped at Chicheng.

sentences.zh: 六年春二月乙卯，晉遣使進先帝遺物。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, in the second month of spring, on day yimao, Jin sent envoys presenting the late emperor's personal effects.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, in the second spring month, on yimao day, Jin sent envoys presenting the late emperor's personal effects.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，晉遣使請居汴，從之。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, Jin sent envoys requesting to reside at Bian; the request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day Jin sent envoys asking to move the court to Bian; the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 三月己卯朔，吳越王遣使來貢。

translations.literal: On the jimao new moon of the third month, the King of Wuyue sent envoys to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On the jimao new moon of the third month the King of Wuyue sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 甲申，梅里喘引來歸。

translations.literal: On day jiashen, Melichuanyin came to submit.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day Melichuanyin came to submit.

sentences.zh: 戊子，南唐遣使奉蠟丸書。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, Southern Tang sent envoys bearing a wax-sealed letter.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day Southern Tang sent envoys bearing a wax-sealed letter.

sentences.zh: 丁未，晉至汴，遣使來謝。

translations.literal: On day dingwei, Jin reached Bian; envoys were sent to express thanks.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day Jin reached Bian, and envoys were sent to express thanks.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊申朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: On the wushen new moon of the fourth month of summer, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: That summer, on the wushen new moon of the fourth month, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 五月己亥，遣使如晉致生辰禮。

translations.literal: On day jihai in the fifth month, envoys were dispatched to Jin to present birthday gifts.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day in the fifth month envoys were sent to Jin with birthday gifts.

sentences.zh: 六月丁未朔，鐵驪來貢。

translations.literal: On the dingwei new moon of the sixth month, the Iron Li came to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei new moon of the sixth month the Iron Li brought tribute.

sentences.zh: 己未，奚鋤骨里部進白麝。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, the Xi Chuguli tribe presented white musk deer.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day the Xi Chuguli tribe presented white musk deer.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，莫州進白鵲。

translations.literal: On day xinyou, Mo Prefecture presented a white magpie.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day Mo Prefecture presented a white magpie.

sentences.zh: 晉遣使貢金。

translations.literal: Jin sent envoys presenting gold.
translations.idiomatic: Jin sent envoys presenting gold.

sentences.zh: 秋八月丁未朔，晉復貢金。

translations.literal: On the dingwei new moon of the eighth month of autumn, Jin again presented gold.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth autumn month, on the dingwei new moon, Jin again presented gold.

sentences.zh: 己未，如奉聖州。

translations.literal: On day jiwei, he went to Fengsheng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day he went to Fengsheng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 晉遣其子延煦來朝。

translations.literal: Jin sent his son Yanshu to court.
translations.idiomatic: Jin sent his son Yanshu to court.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月辛卯，上京留守耶律迪輦得晉諜，知有二心。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of winter, on day xinmao, Supreme Capital garrison commander Yelü Dielian captured a Jin spy and learned of duplicitous intentions.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, in the eleventh month, on xinmao day, Supreme Capital garrison commander Yelü Dielian captured a Jin spy and learned that Jin was of two minds.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，鐵驪來貢。

translations.literal: On day jiachen, the Iron Li came to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day the Iron Li brought tribute.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁未，如南京，議伐晉。

translations.literal: On day dingwei in the twelfth month, he went to Nanjing to deliberate attacking Jin.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day in the twelfth month he went to Nanjing to plan an attack on Jin.

sentences.zh: 命趙延壽、趙延昭、安端、解里等由滄、恆、易、定分道而進，大軍繼之。

translations.literal: Zhao Yanzhou, Zhao Yanzhao, Anduan, Jieli, and others were ordered to advance by separate routes through Cang, Heng, Yi, and Ding; the main army followed.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Yanzhou, Zhao Yanzhao, Anduan, Jieli, and others were ordered to advance by separate routes through Cang, Heng, Yi, and Ding, with the main army following after.

sentences.zh: 是歲，楊彥昭請移鎮奈濼及新鎮，從之。

translations.literal: That year, Yang Yanzhao requested transfer to garrison Nailuo and the new garrison; the request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: That year Yang Yanzhao asked to be transferred to garrison Nailuo and the new garrison, and the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 七年春正月甲戌朔，趙延壽、延昭率前鋒五萬騎次任丘。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, on the jiaxu new moon of the first month of spring, Zhao Yanzhou and Yanzhao led fifty thousand vanguard cavalry to camp at Renqiu.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, on the jiaxu new moon of the first spring month, Zhao Yanzhou and Yanzhao led fifty thousand vanguard horsemen to camp at Renqiu.

sentences.zh: 丙子，安端入雁門，圍忻、代。

translations.literal: On day bingzi, Anduan entered Yanmen Pass and besieged Xin and Dai.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day Anduan entered Yanmen Pass and besieged Xin and Dai.

sentences.zh: 己卯，趙延壽圍貝州，其軍校邵珂開南門納遼兵，太守吳巒投井死。

translations.literal: On day jimao, Zhao Yanzhou besieged Bei Prefecture; army officer Shao Ke opened the south gate to admit Liao troops; prefect Wu Luan threw himself into a well and died.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day Zhao Yanzhou besieged Bei Prefecture; army officer Shao Ke opened the south gate to admit Liao troops, and prefect Wu Luan threw himself into a well and died.

sentences.zh: 己丑，次元城，授延壽魏、博等州節度使，封魏王，率所部屯南樂。

translations.literal: On day jichou, he halted at Yuancheng, appointed Yanzhou military governor of Wei, Bo, and other prefectures, enfeoffed him as Prince of Wei, and had him lead his forces to camp at Nanle.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day he halted at Yuancheng, made Yanzhou military governor of Wei, Bo, and other prefectures, enfeoffed him as Prince of Wei, and had him lead his command to camp at Nanle.

sentences.zh: 丙申，遣兵攻黎陽，晉張彥澤來拒。

translations.literal: On day bingshen, troops were dispatched to attack Liyang; Jin's Zhang Yanzhe came to resist.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day troops were sent to attack Liyang; Jin's Zhang Yanzhe came out to resist.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，晉遣使來修舊好，詔割河北諸州，及遣桑維翰、景延廣來議。

translations.literal: On day xinchou, Jin sent envoys to restore the old amity; an edict ceded the Hebei prefectures and ordered Sang Weihan and Jing Yanguang to come for negotiations.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day Jin sent envoys seeking to restore the old friendship; an edict ceded the Hebei prefectures and ordered Sang Weihan and Jing Yanguang to come and negotiate.

sentences.zh: 二月甲辰朔，攻博州，剌史周儒以城降。

translations.literal: On the jiachen new moon of the second month, Bozhou was attacked; prefect Zhou Ru surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiachen new moon of the second month Bozhou was attacked, and prefect Zhou Ru surrendered the city.

sentences.zh: 晉平盧軍節度使楊光遠密道遼師自馬家口濟河。

translations.literal: Jin's Pinglu Army military governor Yang Guangyuan secretly guided Liao forces across the river at Ma Family Pass.
translations.idiomatic: Jin's Pinglu Army military governor Yang Guangyuan secretly guided Liao forces across the river at Ma Family Pass.

sentences.zh: 晉將景延廣命石斌守麻家口，白再榮守馬家口。

translations.literal: Jin general Jing Yanguang ordered Shi Bin to hold Majia Pass and Bai Zairong to hold Ma Family Pass.
translations.idiomatic: Jin general Jing Yanguang ordered Shi Bin to hold Majia Pass and Bai Zairong to hold Ma Family Pass.

sentences.zh: 未幾，周儒引遼軍麻答營于河東，攻鄆州北津，以應光遠。

translations.literal: Before long, Zhou Ru guided Liao troops under Mada to camp east of the river and attack the north ford of Yan Prefecture, to coordinate with Guangyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Zhou Ru guided Liao troops under Mada to camp east of the river and attack the north ford of Yan Prefecture, to coordinate with Guangyuan.

sentences.zh: 晉遣李守貞、皇甫遇、梁漢璋、薛懷讓將兵萬人，緣河水陸俱進。

translations.literal: Jin dispatched Li Shouzhen, Huangfu Yu, Liang Hanzhang, and Xue Huairang leading ten thousand men, advancing by land and water along the river.
translations.idiomatic: Jin dispatched Li Shouzhen, Huangfu Yu, Liang Hanzhang, and Xue Huairang with ten thousand men, advancing by land and water along the river.

sentences.zh: 遼軍圍晉別將於戚城，晉主自將救之，遼師解去。

translations.literal: Liao troops besieged a Jin detached commander at Qicheng; the Jin emperor personally led troops to the rescue and the Liao army withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Liao troops besieged a Jin detached commander at Qicheng; the Jin emperor personally led troops to the rescue, and the Liao army withdrew.

sentences.zh: 守貞等至馬家口，麻答遣步卒萬人築營壘，騎兵萬人守于外，餘兵屯河西。

translations.literal: Shouzhen and the others reached Ma Family Pass; Mada sent ten thousand foot soldiers to build ramparts, ten thousand cavalry to guard outside, and the rest encamped west of the river.
translations.idiomatic: Shouzhen and the others reached Ma Family Pass; Mada sent ten thousand foot soldiers to build ramparts, ten thousand cavalry to guard outside, and stationed the rest west of the river.

sentences.zh: 渡未已，晉兵薄之，遼軍不利。

translations.literal: Before the crossing was complete, Jin troops pressed them and the Liao army fared badly.
translations.idiomatic: Before the crossing was finished Jin troops pressed them hard, and the Liao army fared badly.

sentences.zh: 三月癸酉朔，趙延壽言：「晉諸軍沿河置柵，皆畏怯不敢戰。

translations.literal: On the guiyou new moon of the third month, Zhao Yanzhou said: "Jin's armies have set palisades along the river, all too fearful to fight.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiyou new moon of the third month Zhao Yanzhou said, "Jin's armies have set palisades along the river and are all too fearful to fight.

sentences.zh: 若率大兵直抵澶淵，據其橋梁，晉必可取。

translations.literal: If we lead the main force straight to Chanyuan and seize its bridges, Jin can surely be taken.
translations.idiomatic: If we lead the main force straight to Chanyuan and seize its bridges, Jin can surely be taken."

sentences.zh: 」是日，晉兵駐澶淵，其前軍高行周在戚城。

translations.literal: " That day Jin troops were encamped at Chanyuan; their vanguard Gao Xingzhou was at Qicheng.
translations.idiomatic: That day Jin troops were encamped at Chanyuan, with their vanguard Gao Xingzhou at Qicheng.
