sentences.zh: 乃命延壽、延昭以數萬騎出行周右，上以精兵出其左。

translations.literal: Zhao Yanzhou and Yanzhao were then ordered with tens of thousands of cavalry to outflank Xingzhou on the right; the Emperor with elite troops on the left.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Yanzhou and Yanzhao were then ordered to take tens of thousands of horsemen around Xingzhou's right, while the Emperor with picked troops struck on the left.

sentences.zh: 戰至暮，上復以勁騎突其中軍，晉軍不能戰。

translations.literal: Fighting until dusk, the Emperor again sent strong cavalry to charge their center; the Jin army could not hold.
translations.idiomatic: They fought until dusk; the Emperor again sent strong cavalry to charge the Jin center, and the Jin army could not stand.

sentences.zh: 會有諜者言晉軍東面數少，沿河城柵不固，乃急擊其東偏，眾皆奔潰。

translations.literal: A spy reported Jin's eastern numbers were few and the riverine palisades insecure; they pressed the eastern flank hard and the masses broke and fled.
translations.idiomatic: A spy reported that Jin's eastern numbers were few and the riverine palisades weak; they pressed the eastern flank hard, and the masses broke and fled.

sentences.zh: 縱兵追及，遂大敗之。

translations.literal: Cavalry was loosed in pursuit and they were utterly routed.
translations.idiomatic: Cavalry was loosed in pursuit, and Jin was utterly routed.

sentences.zh: 壬午，留趙延昭守貝州，徙所俘戶于內地。

translations.literal: On day renwu, Zhao Yanzhao was left to hold Bei Prefecture; captured households were relocated to the interior.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day Zhao Yanzhao was left to hold Bei Prefecture, and captured households were moved into the interior.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸丑，還次南京。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on day guichou, he returned and halted at Nanjing.
translations.idiomatic: That summer, in the fourth month, on guichou day, he returned and halted at Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 辛未，如涼陘。

translations.literal: On day xinwei, he went to Liang Pass.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day he went to Liang Pass.

sentences.zh: 五月癸酉，耶律拔里得奏破德州，擒刺史尹居璠及將吏二十七人。

translations.literal: On day guiyou in the fifth month, Yelü Balide reported capturing Dezhou, taking prefect Yin Juhan and twenty-seven officers and officials prisoner.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day in the fifth month Yelü Balide reported that Dezhou had been taken and prefect Yin Juhan and twenty-seven officers and officials captured.

sentences.zh: 六月甲辰，黑車子室來貢。

translations.literal: On day jiachen in the sixth month, the Black Cart Shiwei came to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day in the sixth month the Black Cart Shiwei brought tribute.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，紝沒里、要里等國來貢。

translations.literal: On day yisi, Renmeili, Yaoli, and other states came to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day Renmeili, Yaoli, and other states came with tribute.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己卯，晉楊光遠遣人奉蠟丸書。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on day jimao, Jin's Yang Guangyuan sent men bearing a wax-sealed letter.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh autumn month, on jimao day, Jin's Yang Guangyuan sent men bearing a wax-sealed letter.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，晉遣張暉奉表乞和，留暉不遣。

translations.literal: On day xinmao, Jin sent Zhang Hui with a memorial begging peace; Hui was detained and not sent back.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day Jin sent Zhang Hui with a memorial begging peace; Hui was detained and not sent back.

sentences.zh: 八月辛酉，回鶻遣使請婚，不許。

translations.literal: On day xinyou in the eighth month, the Uighur sent envoys requesting marriage; it was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day in the eighth month the Uighur sent envoys requesting marriage; the request was denied.

sentences.zh: 是月，晉鎮州兵來襲飛狐，大同軍節度使耶律孔阿戰敗之。

translations.literal: That month, Jin troops from Zhen Prefecture came to raid Feihu; Datong Army military governor Yelü Kong'a defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: That month Jin troops from Zhen Prefecture raided Feihu; Datong Army military governor Yelü Kong'a defeated them.

sentences.zh: 九月庚午朔，北幸。

translations.literal: On the gengwu new moon of the ninth month, he proceeded north on tour.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu new moon of the ninth month he proceeded north on tour.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁未，鼻骨德來貢。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on day dingwei, the Biegude came to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, in the tenth month, on dingwei day, the Biegude brought tribute.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，天授節，諸國進賀，惟晉不至。

translations.literal: On day renxu, on the Tianshou festival, the various states came to offer congratulations; only Jin did not come.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day, at the Tianshou festival, the various states came to offer congratulations; only Jin did not come.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬申，詔征諸道兵，以閏月朔會溫榆河北。

translations.literal: On day renshen in the eleventh month, an edict levied troops from all circuits to assemble north of the Wenyu River on the intercalary month's new moon.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day in the eleventh month an edict levied troops from every circuit to assemble north of the Wenyu River on the intercalary month's new moon.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸卯，南伐。

translations.literal: On day guimao in the twelfth month, a southern campaign was launched.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day in the twelfth month the southern campaign was launched.

sentences.zh: 甲子，次古北口。

translations.literal: On day jiazi, he halted at Gubei Pass.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day he halted at Gubei Pass.

sentences.zh: 閏月己巳朔，閱諸道兵于溫榆河。

translations.literal: On the jisi new moon of the intercalary month, troops from all circuits were reviewed at the Wenyu River.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi new moon of the intercalary month troops from every circuit were reviewed at the Wenyu River.

sentences.zh: 己卯，圍恆州，下其九縣。

translations.literal: On day jimao, Heng Prefecture was besieged and its nine counties were taken.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day Heng Prefecture was besieged and its nine counties were taken.

sentences.zh: 八年春正月庚子，分兵攻邢、洺、磁三州，殺掠殆盡。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, on day gengzi in the first month of spring, forces were divided to attack Xing, Ming, and Ci prefectures; killing and looting were nearly complete.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, on gengzi day in the first spring month, forces were divided to attack Xing, Ming, and Ci prefectures, killing and looting almost without limit.

sentences.zh: 入鄴都境。

translations.literal: They entered the territory of Yedu.
translations.idiomatic: They entered the territory of Yedu.

sentences.zh: 張從恩、馬全節、安審琦兵悉陳于相州安陽水之南。

translations.literal: Zhang Cong'en, Ma Quanjie, and An Shenqi drew up all their forces south of the Anyang River at Xiang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Cong'en, Ma Quanjie, and An Shenqi drew up all their forces south of the Anyang River at Xiang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 皇甫遇與濮州刺史慕容彥超將兵千騎來覘遼軍。

translations.literal: Huangfu Yu and Puzhou prefect Murong Yanchao led a thousand horsemen to scout the Liao army.
translations.idiomatic: Huangfu Yu and Puzhou prefect Murong Yanchao led a thousand horsemen to scout the Liao army.

sentences.zh: 至鄴都，遇遼軍數萬，且戰且卻，至榆林店。

translations.literal: Reaching Yedu, they met tens of thousands of Liao troops; fighting as they retreated, they reached Yulin Inn.
translations.idiomatic: Reaching Yedu they met tens of thousands of Liao troops; fighting as they fell back, they reached Yulin Inn.

sentences.zh: 遼軍繼至，遇與彥超力戰百餘合，遇馬斃，步戰，審琦引騎兵逾水以救，遼軍乃還。

translations.literal: Liao troops pressed after them; Yu and Yanchao fought strenuously for more than a hundred rounds; Yu's horse was killed and he fought on foot; Shenqi led cavalry across the water to the rescue and the Liao army withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Liao troops pressed after them; Yu and Yanchao fought strenuously for more than a hundred rounds; Yu's horse was killed and he fought on foot; Shenqi led cavalry across the river to the rescue, and the Liao army withdrew.

sentences.zh: 二月，圍魏，晉將杜重威率兵來救。

translations.literal: In the second month, Wei was besieged; Jin general Du Chongwei led troops to the rescue.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month Wei was besieged; Jin general Du Chongwei led troops to the rescue.

sentences.zh: 戊子，晉將折從阮陷勝州。

translations.literal: On day wuzi, Jin general Zhe Congruan captured Sheng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day Jin general Zhe Congruan captured Sheng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 三月戊戌，師拔祁州，殺其刺史沈斌。

translations.literal: In the third month, on wuxu day, the army took Qi Prefecture and killed its prefect Shen Bin.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on wuxu day, the army captured Qi Prefecture and killed its prefect Shen Bin.

sentences.zh: 庚子，杜重威、李守貞攻泰州。

translations.literal: On gengzi day, Du Chongwei and Li Shouzhen attacked Tai Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day Du Chongwei and Li Shouzhen attacked Tai Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 戊子，趙延壽率前鋒薄泰城。

translations.literal: On wuzi day, Zhao Yanshou led the vanguard to press Tai city.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day Zhao Yanshou led the vanguard to press close to Tai city.

sentences.zh: 己未，重威、守貞引兵南遁，追至陽城，大敗之。

translations.literal: On jiwei day, Chongwei and Shouzhen led their troops in flight south; they were pursued to Yangcheng and suffered a great defeat.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day Chongwei and Shouzhen led their troops in flight south; pursuers caught them at Yangcheng and inflicted a great defeat.

sentences.zh: 復以步卒為方陣來拒，與戰二十餘合。

translations.literal: They again drew up foot soldiers in square formations to resist; they fought for more than twenty rounds.
translations.idiomatic: They again formed foot soldiers into square battle lines to resist, and the two sides fought for more than twenty rounds.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，復搏戰十餘里。

translations.literal: On renxu day, they fought again for more than ten li.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day they fought again for more than ten li.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，圍晉兵于白團衛村。

translations.literal: On guihai day, Jin troops were besieged at Baituanwei Village.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day Jin troops were besieged at Baituanwei Village.

sentences.zh: 晉兵下鹿角為營。

translations.literal: Jin troops set down antler palisades and made camp.
translations.idiomatic: Jin troops set down antler palisades and encamped.

sentences.zh: 是夕大風。

translations.literal: That evening there was a great wind.
translations.idiomatic: That evening a great wind rose.

sentences.zh: 至曙，命鐵鷂軍下馬，拔其鹿角，奮短兵入擊。

translations.literal: At dawn the Emperor ordered the Iron Hawk corps to dismount, pull up their antler palisades, and charge in with short weapons.
translations.idiomatic: At dawn the Emperor ordered the Iron Hawk corps to dismount, pull up the antler palisades, and charge in with short weapons.

sentences.zh: 順風縱火揚塵，以助其勢。

translations.literal: With the wind at their backs they set fires and raised dust to aid their momentum.
translations.idiomatic: With the wind at their backs they set fires and raised dust to strengthen their attack.

sentences.zh: 晉軍大呼曰：「都招討何不用兵，令士卒徒死！

translations.literal: Jin troops shouted aloud: "Supreme commander, why do you not use your troops and let the soldiers die for nothing!
translations.idiomatic: Jin troops shouted aloud, "Supreme commander, why do you not commit your forces and let the soldiers die for nothing!

sentences.zh: 」諸將皆奮出戰。

translations.literal: " All the generals eagerly sallied forth to fight.
translations.idiomatic: " All the generals eagerly sallied forth to fight.

sentences.zh: 張彥澤、藥元福、皇甫遇出兵大戰，諸將繼至，遼軍卻數百步。

translations.literal: Zhang Yanze, Yao Yuanfu, and Huangfu Yu led troops out in a great battle; other generals followed in succession, and the Liao army was driven back several hundred paces.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yanze, Yao Yuanfu, and Huangfu Yu led troops out in a great battle; other generals followed in turn, and the Liao army was driven back several hundred paces.

sentences.zh: 風益甚，晝晦如夜。

translations.literal: The wind grew fiercer; daylight was dark as night.
translations.idiomatic: The wind grew fiercer still, and daylight turned dark as night.

sentences.zh: 符彥卿以萬騎橫擊遼軍，率步卒並進，遼軍不利。

translations.literal: Fu Yanqing with ten thousand horsemen struck the Liao army from the flank, leading foot soldiers forward together; the Liao army fared badly.
translations.idiomatic: Fu Yanqing with ten thousand horsemen struck the Liao army from the flank and led foot soldiers forward together; the Liao army fared badly.

sentences.zh: 上乘奚車退十餘里，晉追兵急，獲一橐駝乘之乃歸。

translations.literal: The Emperor rode in a Xi chariot and withdrew more than ten li; Jin pursuers pressed hard, and he obtained a camel and rode it back.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor rode in a Xi chariot and withdrew more than ten li; Jin pursuers pressed hard, so he seized a camel, mounted it, and returned.

sentences.zh: 晉兵退保定州。

translations.literal: Jin troops withdrew to Baoding Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Jin troops withdrew to Baoding Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲申，還次南京，杖戰不力者各數百。

translations.literal: That summer, in the fourth month, on jiashen day, he returned and halted at Nanjing; several hundred who had fought poorly were flogged.
translations.idiomatic: That summer, in the fourth month, on jiashen day, he returned and halted at Nanjing; several hundred men who had fought poorly were flogged.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，宴將士于元和殿。

translations.literal: On gengyin day he feasted the commanders and soldiers in the Hall of Primordial Harmony.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day he feasted the commanders and soldiers in the Hall of Primordial Harmony.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，如涼陘。

translations.literal: On guisi day he went to Liang Pass.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day he went to Liang Pass.

sentences.zh: 六月戊辰，回鶻來貢。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on wuchen day, the Uighur came to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on wuchen day, the Uighur brought tribute.

sentences.zh: 辛未，吐谷渾、鼻骨德皆來貢。

translations.literal: On xinwei day the Tuyuhun and Biegude all came to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day the Tuyuhun and Biegude both brought tribute.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，黑車子室韋來貢。

translations.literal: On xinsi day the Black Cart Shiwei came to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day the Black Cart Shiwei brought tribute.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，趙延壽奏晉兵襲高陽，戍將擊走之。

translations.literal: On dinghai day Zhao Yanshou reported that Jin troops had raided Gaoyang and that garrison troops had driven them off.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day Zhao Yanshou reported that Jin troops had raided Gaoyang and that the garrison had driven them off.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙卯，獵平地松林。

translations.literal: In the seventh autumn month, on yimao day, he hunted at Pingdi Pine Forest.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh autumn month, on yimao day, he hunted at Pingdi Pine Forest.

sentences.zh: 晉遣孟守中奉表請和，仍以前事答之。

translations.literal: Jin dispatched Meng Shouzhong bearing a memorial requesting peace; the Emperor answered as before.
translations.idiomatic: Jin dispatched Meng Shouzhong bearing a memorial requesting peace, and the Emperor answered as he had before.

sentences.zh: 八月己巳，詔侍衛蕭素撒閱群牧于北陘。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on jisi day, an edict ordered Imperial Guard Xiao Susa to inspect the herds at North Pass.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jisi day, an edict ordered Imperial Guard Xiao Susa to inspect the herds at North Pass.

sentences.zh: 九月壬寅，次赤山，宴從臣，問軍國要務，對曰：「軍國之務，愛民為本。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on renyin day, he halted at Red Mountain, feasted his attendant ministers, and asked about matters vital to army and state; they answered: "In matters of army and state, loving the people is fundamental.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on renyin day, he halted at Red Mountain, feasted his attendant ministers, and asked about matters vital to army and state; they answered, "In matters of army and state, loving the people is fundamental.

sentences.zh: 民富則兵足，兵足則國強。

translations.literal: When the people are rich the army is sufficient; when the army is sufficient the state is strong.
translations.idiomatic: When the people are rich the army is sufficient; when the army is sufficient the state is strong.

sentences.zh: 」上以為然。

translations.literal: " The Emperor agreed.
translations.idiomatic: " The Emperor agreed.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，還上京。

translations.literal: On xinyou day he returned to the Supreme Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day he returned to the Supreme Capital.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛未，祠木葉山。

translations.literal: That winter, in the tenth month, on xinwei day, he sacrificed at Mount Muye.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, in the tenth month, on xinwei day, he sacrificed at Mount Muye.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊戌，女直、鐵驪來貢。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on wuxu day, the Jurchen and Iron Li came to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on wuxu day, the Jurchen and Iron Li brought tribute.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸亥朔，朝謁太祖行宮。

translations.literal: On the guihai new moon of the twelfth month he paid court at Emperor Taizu's traveling palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai new moon of the twelfth month he paid court at Emperor Taizu's traveling palace.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，雲州節度使耶律孔阿獲晉諜者。

translations.literal: On yichou day Yun Prefecture military governor Yelü Kong'a captured a Jin spy.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day Yun Prefecture military governor Yelü Kong'a captured a Jin spy.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，臘，賜諸國貢使衣馬。

translations.literal: On wuchen day, at the La festival, robe and horses were bestowed on tribute envoys from the various states.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day, at the La festival, robes and horses were bestowed on tribute envoys from the various states.

sentences.zh: 九年春正月庚子，回鶻來貢。

translations.literal: In year nine, in the first spring month, on gengzi day, the Uighur came to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, in the first spring month, on gengzi day, the Uighur brought tribute.

sentences.zh: 丁未，女直來貢。

translations.literal: On dingwei day the Jurchen came to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day the Jurchen brought tribute.

sentences.zh: 二月戊辰，鼻骨德奏軍籍。

translations.literal: In the second month, on wuchen day, the Biegude submitted military registers.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on wuchen day, the Biegude submitted military registers.

sentences.zh: 三月乙亥，吐谷渾遣軍校恤烈獻生口千戶，授恤烈檢校司空。

translations.literal: In the third month, on yihai day, the Tuyuhun sent military officer Xulie presenting a thousand captive households; Xulie was appointed acting Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on yihai day, the Tuyuhun sent military officer Xulie presenting a thousand captive households, and Xulie was appointed acting Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛酉朔，吐谷渾白可久來附。

translations.literal: That summer, on the xinyou new moon of the fourth month, Tuyuhun Bokejiu came to submit.
translations.idiomatic: That summer, on the xinyou new moon of the fourth month, Tuyuhun Bokejiu came to submit.

sentences.zh: 是月，如涼陘。

translations.literal: That month he went to Liang Pass.
translations.idiomatic: That month he went to Liang Pass.

sentences.zh: 五月庚戌，晉易州戍將孫方簡請內附。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on gengxu day, Jin's Yizhou garrison commander Sun Fangjian requested to defect inward.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on gengxu day, Jin's Yizhou garrison commander Sun Fangjian asked to defect inward.

sentences.zh: 六月戊子，謁祖陵，更閟神殿為長思。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on wuzi day, he visited the ancestral tombs and renamed Bisi Hall Longsi.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on wuzi day, he visited the ancestral tombs and renamed Bisi Hall Longsi.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛亥，詔征諸道兵，敢傷禾稼者，以軍法論。

translations.literal: In the seventh autumn month, on xinhai day, an edict levied troops from all circuits; anyone who dared harm standing grain would be punished by military law.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh autumn month, on xinhai day, an edict levied troops from every circuit; anyone who dared harm standing grain would be punished by military law.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，女直來貢。

translations.literal: On guichou day the Jurchen came to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day the Jurchen brought tribute.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以阻卜酋長曷剌為本部夷離堇。

translations.literal: On yimao day Zubu chieftain Ela was made tribal chief of his own branch.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day Zubu chieftain Ela was made tribal chief of his own branch.

sentences.zh: 八月丙寅，烏古來貢。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on bingyin day, the Wugu came to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on bingyin day, the Wugu brought tribute.

sentences.zh: 是月，自將南伐。

translations.literal: That month the Emperor personally led a southern campaign.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Emperor personally led a southern campaign.

sentences.zh: 九月壬辰，閱諸道兵于漁陽西棗林淀。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on renchen day, troops from all circuits were reviewed at Zhaolin Marsh west of Yuyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on renchen day, troops from every circuit were reviewed at Zhaolin Marsh west of Yuyang.

sentences.zh: 是月，趙延壽與晉張彥澤戰于定州，敗之。

translations.literal: That month Zhao Yanshou fought Jin's Zhang Yanze at Ding Prefecture and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: That month Zhao Yanshou fought Jin's Zhang Yanze at Ding Prefecture and defeated him.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月戊子朔，進圍鎮州。

translations.literal: That winter, on the wuzi new moon of the eleventh month, he advanced to besiege Zhen Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, on the wuzi new moon of the eleventh month, he advanced to besiege Zhen Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丙申，先遣候騎報晉兵至，遣精兵斷河橋，晉兵退保武強。

translations.literal: On bingshen day scouts were sent ahead reporting Jin troops had arrived; picked troops were sent to cut the river bridge, and Jin troops withdrew to hold Wuqiang.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day scouts were sent ahead reporting that Jin troops had arrived; picked troops were dispatched to cut the river bridge, and Jin troops withdrew to hold Wuqiang.

sentences.zh: 南院大王迪輦、將軍高模翰分兵由瀛州間道以進，杜重威遣貝州節度使梁漢璋率眾來拒。

translations.literal: Southern Court Great King Dielian and general Gao Mohan divided their forces and advanced by secret routes through Ying Prefecture; Du Chongwei dispatched Bei Prefecture military governor Liang Hanzhang leading masses to resist.
translations.idiomatic: Southern Court Great King Dielian and general Gao Mohan divided their forces and advanced by secret routes through Ying Prefecture; Du Chongwei dispatched Bei Prefecture military governor Liang Hanzhang with a host to resist.

sentences.zh: 與戰，大敗之，殺梁漢璋。

translations.literal: They gave battle, inflicted a great defeat, and killed Liang Hanzhang.
translations.idiomatic: They gave battle, inflicted a great defeat, and killed Liang Hanzhang.

sentences.zh: 杜重威、張彥澤引兵據中渡橋，趙延壽以步卒前擊，高彥溫以騎兵乘之，追奔逐北，殭屍數萬，斬其將王清，宋彥筠墮水死。

translations.literal: Du Chongwei and Zhang Yanze led troops to hold Zhongdu Bridge; Zhao Yanshou struck ahead with foot soldiers and Gao Yanwen pressed with cavalry; pursuing the fleeing enemy, corpses numbered in the tens of thousands; Jin general Wang Qing was beheaded and Song Yanjun drowned.
translations.idiomatic: Du Chongwei and Zhang Yanze led troops to hold Zhongdu Bridge; Zhao Yanshou struck ahead with foot soldiers and Gao Yanwen pressed with cavalry; pursuing the fleeing enemy, corpses numbered in the tens of thousands; Jin general Wang Qing was beheaded and Song Yanjun drowned.

sentences.zh: 重威等退保中渡寨。

translations.literal: Chongwei and the others withdrew to hold Zhongdu stockade.
translations.idiomatic: Chongwei and the others withdrew to hold Zhongdu stockade.

sentences.zh: 義武軍節度使李殷以城降，遂進兵，夾滹沱而營。

translations.literal: Yiwu Army military governor Li Yin surrendered the city; troops then advanced and encamped on both sides of the Hutuo.
translations.idiomatic: Yiwu Army military governor Li Yin surrendered the city; the army then advanced and encamped on both sides of the Hutuo.

sentences.zh: 去中渡寨三里，分兵圍之。

translations.literal: Three li from Zhongdu stockade they divided forces to besiege it.
translations.idiomatic: Three li from Zhongdu stockade they divided forces to besiege it.

sentences.zh: 夜則列騎環守，晝則出兵抄掠。

translations.literal: By night cavalry was arrayed in a ring guard; by day troops were sent out to raid.
translations.idiomatic: By night cavalry was arrayed in a ring guard; by day troops were sent out to raid.

sentences.zh: 覆命大內惕隱耶律朔骨里及趙延壽分兵圍守，自將騎卒夜渡河出其後。

translations.literal: He further ordered Inner Court chief minister Yelü Shuoguli and Zhao Yanshou to divide forces for siege and guard; he personally led horse soldiers to cross the river by night and come up behind them.
translations.idiomatic: He further ordered Inner Court chief minister Yelü Shuoguli and Zhao Yanshou to divide forces for siege and guard, while he personally led horsemen to cross the river by night and come up behind them.

sentences.zh: 攻下欒城，降騎卒數千。

translations.literal: Luancheng was taken; several thousand mounted soldiers surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Luancheng was taken and several thousand mounted soldiers surrendered.

sentences.zh: 分遣將士據其要害。

translations.literal: Officers and soldiers were sent forth separately to hold the critical points.
translations.idiomatic: Officers and soldiers were sent forth separately to hold the critical points.

sentences.zh: 於是軍中預備軍食，三日不得舉煙火，但獲晉人，即黥而縱之。

translations.literal: Thereupon the army prepared provisions; for three days no smoke or fire was permitted; whenever a Jin man was captured he was tattooed and released.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon the army prepared provisions; for three days no smoke or fire was permitted; whenever a Jin man was captured he was tattooed and released.

sentences.zh: 諸饋運見者皆棄而走。

translations.literal: All supply convoys that saw this abandoned their loads and fled.
translations.idiomatic: All supply convoys that saw this abandoned their loads and fled.

sentences.zh: 於是晉兵內外隔絕，食盡勢窮。

translations.literal: Thereupon Jin troops were cut off inside and out; provisions were exhausted and their situation desperate.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Jin troops were cut off inside and out; provisions were exhausted and their situation desperate.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙寅，杜重威、李守貞、張彥澤等率所部二十萬眾來降。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on bingyin day, Du Chongwei, Li Shouzhen, Zhang Yanze, and others led two hundred thousand under their command to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on bingyin day, Du Chongwei, Li Shouzhen, Zhang Yanze, and others led two hundred thousand men under their command to surrender.

sentences.zh: 上擁數萬騎，臨大阜，立馬以受之。

translations.literal: The Emperor with tens of thousands of horsemen came to a great knoll, halted his horse, and received their surrender.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor with tens of thousands of horsemen came to a great knoll, halted his horse, and received their surrender.

sentences.zh: 授重威守太傅、鄴都留守，守貞天平軍節度使，餘各領舊職。

translations.literal: Chongwei was appointed acting Grand Mentor and Yedu garrison commander; Shouzhen was made Tianping Army military governor; the rest kept their former posts.
translations.idiomatic: Chongwei was appointed acting Grand Mentor and Yedu garrison commander; Shouzhen was made Tianping Army military governor; the rest kept their former posts.

sentences.zh: 分降卒之半付重威，半以隸趙延壽。

translations.literal: Half the surrendered soldiers were given to Chongwei, half assigned to Zhao Yanshou.
translations.idiomatic: Half the surrendered soldiers were given to Chongwei and half assigned to Zhao Yanshou.

sentences.zh: 命御史大夫解里、監軍傅桂兒、張彥澤持詔入汴，諭晉帝母李氏，以安其意，且召桑維翰、景延廣先來。

translations.literal: He ordered Censor-in-Chief Jieli, army inspector Fu Gui'er, and Zhang Yanze to carry the edict into Bian, explain matters to Jin emperor's mother Lady Li to reassure her, and summon Sang Weihan and Jing Yanguang to come first.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered Censor-in-Chief Jieli, army inspector Fu Gui'er, and Zhang Yanze to carry the edict into Bian, explain matters to the Jin emperor's mother Lady Li to reassure her, and summon Sang Weihan and Jing Yanguang to come first.

sentences.zh: 留騎兵千人守魏，自率大軍而南。

translations.literal: A thousand horsemen were left to hold Wei; he personally led the great army south.
translations.idiomatic: A thousand horsemen were left to hold Wei while he personally led the great army south.

sentences.zh: 壬申，解里等至汴，晉帝重貴素服拜命，輿母李氏奉表請罪。

translations.literal: On renshen day Jieli and the others reached Bian; Jin emperor Chonggui in plain robes accepted the command; he conveyed his mother Lady Li presenting a memorial begging forgiveness.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day Jieli and the others reached Bian; Jin emperor Chonggui in plain robes accepted the command and conveyed his mother Lady Li presenting a memorial begging forgiveness.

sentences.zh: 初，重貴絕和好，維翰數諫止之，不從，至是彥澤殺維翰，紿言自經死。

translations.literal: Initially Chonggui had severed the peace; Weihan repeatedly remonstrated and was not heeded; now Yanze killed Weihan and falsely claimed he had hanged himself.
translations.idiomatic: Initially Chonggui had severed the peace; Weihan repeatedly remonstrated and was not heeded; now Yanze killed Weihan and falsely claimed he had hanged himself.

sentences.zh: 詔收葬之，復其田園第宅，仍厚恤其家。

translations.literal: An edict ordered his burial and restoration of his fields, gardens, and mansion, with generous relief to his family.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered his burial and restoration of his fields, gardens, and mansion, with generous relief to his family.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，彥澤遷重貴及其母若妻于開封府署，以控鶴指揮使李榮督兵衛之。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day Yanze moved Chonggui and his mother and wife to the Kaifeng prefectural office; Control Crane director Li Rong was ordered to supervise troops guarding them.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day Yanze moved Chonggui and his mother and wife to the Kaifeng prefectural office; Control Crane director Li Rong was ordered to supervise troops guarding them.

sentences.zh: 壬午，次赤岡。

translations.literal: On renwu day he halted at Red Knoll.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day he halted at Red Knoll.

sentences.zh: 重貴舉族出封丘門，稿索牽羊以待。

translations.literal: Chonggui led his entire clan out through Fengqiu Gate, with straw ropes and leading a sheep in waiting.
translations.idiomatic: Chonggui led his entire clan out through Fengqiu Gate, with straw ropes and a sheep in hand, waiting in submission.

sentences.zh: 上不忍臨視，命改館封禪寺。

translations.literal: The Emperor could not bear to look upon it and ordered him lodged instead at Fengchan Temple.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor could not bear to look upon it and ordered him lodged instead at Fengchan Temple.

sentences.zh: 晉百官縞衣紗帽，俯伏待罪。

translations.literal: Jin's hundred officials in white mourning cloth and gauze caps prostrated themselves awaiting judgment.
translations.idiomatic: Jin's hundred officials in white mourning cloth and gauze caps prostrated themselves awaiting judgment.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「其主負恩，其臣何罪。

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "Their lord betrayed favor; what crime have his ministers committed?
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "Their lord betrayed favor; what crime have his ministers committed?

sentences.zh: 」命領職如故，即授安叔千金吾衛上將軍。

translations.literal: " He ordered them to keep their posts as before, and immediately appointed An Shuqi Golden Wield Guard senior general.
translations.idiomatic: " He ordered them to keep their posts as before and immediately appointed An Shuqi Golden Wield Guard senior general.

sentences.zh: 叔千出班獨立，上曰：「汝邢州之請，朕所不忘。

translations.literal: Shuqi stepped forward alone from the ranks; the Emperor said: "Your petition at Xing Prefecture I have not forgotten.
translations.idiomatic: Shuqi stepped forward alone from the ranks; the Emperor said, "Your petition at Xing Prefecture I have not forgotten.

sentences.zh: 」乃加鎮國軍節度使，蓋在邢嘗密請內附也。

translations.literal: " He was further made Zhenguo Army military governor, for at Xing he had once secretly requested to defect inward.
translations.idiomatic: " He was further made Zhenguo Army military governor, for at Xing he had once secretly requested to defect inward.

sentences.zh: 將軍康祥執景延廣來獻，詔以牙籌數其罪，凡八，縶送都，道自殺。

translations.literal: General Kang Xiang seized Jing Yanguang and brought him in; an edict counted his crimes with tally sticks, eight in all; he was bound and sent to the capital and killed himself on the road.
translations.idiomatic: General Kang Xiang seized Jing Yanguang and brought him in; an edict counted his crimes with tally sticks, eight in all; he was bound and sent to the capital and killed himself on the road.

sentences.zh: 大同元年春正月丁亥朔，備法駕入汴，御崇元殿受百官賀。

translations.literal: In the first year of Datong, on the dinghai new moon of the first spring month, the full imperial procession entered Bian; he ascended the Hall of August Primacy to receive congratulations from the hundred officials.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Datong, on the dinghai new moon of the first spring month, the full imperial procession entered Bian; he ascended the Hall of August Primacy to receive congratulations from the hundred officials.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以樞密副使劉敏權知開封府，殺秦繼旻、李彥紳及鄭州防禦使楊承勛，以其弟承信為平盧軍節度使，襲父爵。

translations.literal: On wuzi day Deputy Palace Secretariat Liu Min was made acting Kaifeng prefect; Qin Jimin, Li Yanphen, and Zheng Prefecture defense commissioner Yang Chengzhun were executed; his younger brother Chengxin was made Pinglu Army military governor, succeeding to his father's title.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day Deputy Palace Secretariat Liu Min was made acting Kaifeng prefect; Qin Jimin, Li Yanphen, and Zheng Prefecture defense commissioner Yang Chengzhun were executed; his younger brother Chengxin was made Pinglu Army military governor, succeeding to his father's title.

sentences.zh: 初，楊光遠在青州求內附，其子承勛不聽，殺其判官丘濤及弟承祚等自歸於晉，故誅之。

translations.literal: Initially Yang Guangyuan at Qingzhou had sought to defect inward; his son Chengzhun refused to listen, killed his aide Qiutao and his younger brother Chengzuo and the like and submitted to Jin on his own, hence the execution.
translations.idiomatic: Initially Yang Guangyuan at Qingzhou had sought to defect inward; his son Chengzhun refused to listen, killed his aide Qiutao and his younger brother Chengzuo and the like and submitted to Jin on his own, hence the execution.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以張彥澤擅徙重貴開封，殺桑維翰，縱兵大掠，不道，斬於市。

translations.literal: On jichou day, because Zhang Yanze had on his own authority moved Chonggui to Kaifeng, killed Sang Weihan, and let his troops plunder greatly, behaving without the Way, he was beheaded in the marketplace.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day, because Zhang Yanze had on his own authority moved Chonggui to Kaifeng, killed Sang Weihan, and let his troops plunder greatly, behaving without the Way, he was beheaded in the marketplace.

sentences.zh: 晉人臠食之。

translations.literal: Jin people cut his flesh and ate it.
translations.idiomatic: Jin people cut his flesh and ate it.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，降重貴為崇祿大夫、檢校太尉，封負義侯。

translations.literal: On xinmao day Chonggui was demoted to Grand Master for Splendid Happiness and acting Grand Commandant, enfeoffed as Marquis who Betrayed Right.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day Chonggui was demoted to Grand Master for Splendid Happiness and acting Grand Commandant, enfeoffed as Marquis who Betrayed Right.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以張礪為平章事，晉李崧為樞密使，馮道為太傅，和凝為翰林學士，趙瑩為太子太保，劉昫守太保，馮玉為太子少保。

translations.literal: On guisi day Zhang Li was made Grand Counselor; Jin's Li Song was made Palace Secretariat commissioner; Feng Dao was made Grand Mentor; He Ning was made Hanlin Academician; Zhao Ying was made Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent; Liu Xu was appointed acting Grand Mentor; Feng Yu was made Junior Mentor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day Zhang Li was made Grand Counselor; Jin's Li Song was made Palace Secretariat commissioner; Feng Dao was made Grand Mentor; He Ning was made Hanlin Academician; Zhao Ying was made Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent; Liu Xu was appointed acting Grand Mentor; Feng Yu was made Junior Mentor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，遣趙瑩、馮玉、李彥韜將三百騎送負義侯及其母李氏、太妃安氏、妻馮氏、弟重睿、子延煦、延寶等于黃龍府安置。

translations.literal: On guimao day Zhao Ying, Feng Yu, and Li Yantao were dispatched with three hundred horsemen to escort the Marquis who Betrayed Right and his mother Lady Li, consort Lady An, wife Lady Feng, younger brother Chongrui, sons Yanshu and Yanbao, and others to Huanglong Prefecture for settlement.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day Zhao Ying, Feng Yu, and Li Yantao were dispatched with three hundred horsemen to escort the Marquis who Betrayed Right and his mother Lady Li, consort Lady An, wife Lady Feng, younger brother Chongrui, sons Yanshu and Yanbao, and others to Huanglong Prefecture for settlement.

sentences.zh: 仍以其宮女五十人、內宦三人、東西班五十人、醫官一人、控鶴四人、庖丁七人、茶酒司三人、儀鸞三人、健卒十人從之。

translations.literal: Fifty palace women, three inner eunuchs, fifty men of the eastern and western shifts, one medical officer, four Control Crane guards, seven cooks, three tea-and-wine bureau officers, three ceremonial guards, and ten stout soldiers were sent to accompany them.
translations.idiomatic: Fifty palace women, three inner eunuchs, fifty men of the eastern and western shifts, one medical officer, four Control Crane guards, seven cooks, three tea-and-wine bureau officers, three ceremonial guards, and ten stout soldiers were sent to accompany them.

sentences.zh: 二月丁巳朔，建國號大遼，大赦，改元大同。

translations.literal: On the dingsi new moon of the second month the state name Great Liao was established, a general amnesty was proclaimed, and the era name Datong was adopted.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi new moon of the second month the state name Great Liao was established, a general amnesty was proclaimed, and the era name Datong was adopted.

sentences.zh: 升鎮州為中京。

translations.literal: Zhen Prefecture was elevated to Central Capital.
translations.idiomatic: Zhen Prefecture was elevated to Central Capital.

sentences.zh: 以趙延壽為大丞相兼政事令、樞密使、中京留守，中外官僚將士爵賞有差。

translations.literal: Zhao Yanshou was made Grand Chancellor concurrently Director of Affairs, Palace Secretariat commissioner, and Central Capital garrison commander; civil and military officers and soldiers received titles and rewards in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Yanshou was made Grand Chancellor concurrently Director of Affairs, Palace Secretariat commissioner, and Central Capital garrison commander; civil and military officers and soldiers received titles and rewards in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 辛未，河東節度使北平王劉知遠自立為帝，國號漢。

translations.literal: On xinwei day Hedong military governor, Prince of Beiping Liu Zhiyuan declared himself emperor; his state name was Han.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day Hedong military governor, Prince of Beiping Liu Zhiyuan declared himself emperor; his state name was Han.

sentences.zh: 詔以耿崇美為昭義軍節度使，高唐英為昭德軍節度使，崔廷勛為河陽軍節度使，分據要地。

translations.literal: An edict appointed Geng Chongmei Zhao-Yi Army military governor, Gao Tangying Zhaode Army military governor, and Cui Tingxun Heyang Army military governor to hold critical points respectively.
translations.idiomatic: An edict appointed Geng Chongmei Zhao-Yi Army military governor, Gao Tangying Zhaode Army military governor, and Cui Tingxun Heyang Army military governor to hold critical points respectively.

sentences.zh: 三月丙戌朔，以蕭翰為宣武軍節度使，賜將吏爵賞有差。

translations.literal: On the bingxu new moon of the third month, Xiao Han was made Xuanwu Army military governor; generals and officers were granted titles and rewards differing in grade.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu new moon of the third month Xiao Han was appointed Xuanwu Army military governor; generals and officers received titles and rewards in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，晉諸司僚吏、嬪御、宦寺、方技、百工、圖籍、歷象、石經、銅人、明堂刻漏、太常樂譜、諸宮縣、鹵簿、法物及鎧仗，悉送上京。

translations.literal: On renyin day, Jin's officials from all bureaus, consorts, eunuchs, specialists, artisans, maps and registers, calendars and astronomy, stone classics, bronze mannequins, clepsydra of the Bright Hall, Music Bureau scores, palace and county records, imperial regalia, ritual objects, and armor and weapons were all sent to the Supreme Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day Jin's bureau officials, consorts, eunuchs, specialists, artisans, maps and registers, calendars and astronomical instruments, stone classics, bronze mannequins, Bright Hall clepsydra, Music Bureau scores, palace and county records, imperial regalia, ritual objects, and armor and weapons were all sent to the Supreme Capital.

sentences.zh: 磁州帥梁暉以相州降漢，己酉，命高唐英討之。

translations.literal: Cizhou commander Liang Hui surrendered Xiang Prefecture to Han; on jiyou day Gao Tangying was ordered to attack him.
translations.idiomatic: Cizhou commander Liang Hui surrendered Xiang Prefecture to Han; on jiyou day Gao Tangying was ordered to attack him.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙辰朔，發自汴州，以馮道、李崧、和凝、李浣、徐台符、張礪等從行。

translations.literal: That summer, on the bingchen new moon of the fourth month, he departed from Bian, taking Feng Dao, Li Song, He Ning, Li Huan, Xu Taifu, Zhang Li, and others with him.
translations.idiomatic: That summer, on the bingchen new moon of the fourth month, he set out from Bian with Feng Dao, Li Song, He Ning, Li Huan, Xu Taifu, Zhang Li, and others in attendance.

sentences.zh: 次赤岡，夜有聲如雷，起于御幄，大星復隕于旗鼓前。

translations.literal: Halting at Red Knoll, at night there was a sound like thunder rising from the imperial tent; a great star again fell before the banners and drums.
translations.idiomatic: When he halted at Red Knoll, a sound like thunder rose from the imperial tent at night, and a great star again fell before the banners and drums.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，濟黎陽渡，顧謂侍臣曰：「朕此行有三失：縱兵掠芻粟，一也；

translations.literal: On yichou day, crossing the Liyang ford, he turned to his attendants and said: "On this journey I have three faults: allowing troops to plunder fodder and grain — that is the first;
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day, after crossing the Liyang ford, he turned to his attendants and said, "On this journey I have three faults: allowing troops to plunder fodder and grain — that is the first;

sentences.zh: 括民私財，二也；

translations.literal: requisitioning private wealth from the people — that is the second;
translations.idiomatic: requisitioning private wealth from the people — that is the second;

sentences.zh: 不遽遣諸節度還鎮，三也。

translations.literal: not promptly sending the military governors back to their posts — that is the third.
translations.idiomatic: not promptly sending the military governors back to their posts — that is the third.

sentences.zh: 」皇太弟遣使問軍前事，上報曰：「初以兵二十萬降杜重威、張彥澤，下鎮州。

translations.literal: " The Imperial Younger Brother sent an envoy to inquire about affairs at the front; the Emperor replied: "At first with two hundred thousand troops Du Chongwei and Zhang Yanze submitted, and we took Zhen Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: " The Imperial Younger Brother sent an envoy to inquire about affairs at the front; the Emperor replied, "At first with two hundred thousand troops I made Du Chongwei and Zhang Yanze submit and took Zhen Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 及入汴，視其官屬具員者省之，當其才者任之。

translations.literal: When we entered Bian, we reduced offices where staffs were at full complement and put men to posts according to their talents.
translations.idiomatic: When we entered Bian, I reduced offices where staffs were at full complement and put men to posts according to their talents.

sentences.zh: 司屬雖存，官吏廢墮，猶雛飛之後，徒有空巢。

translations.literal: Though the bureaus remained, the officials were ruined and decayed — like after fledglings have flown, nothing but empty nests.
translations.idiomatic: Though the bureaus remained, the officials were ruined and decayed — like after fledglings have flown, nothing but empty nests.

sentences.zh: 久經離亂，一至於此。

translations.literal: Long torn by turmoil, things had come to this.
translations.idiomatic: Long torn by turmoil, things had come to this.

sentences.zh: 所在盜賊屯結，土功不息，饋餉非時，民不堪命。

translations.literal: Everywhere bandits gathered; earthworks never ceased; supplies came at the wrong times; the people could not bear the burden.
translations.idiomatic: Everywhere bandits gathered; earthworks never ceased; supplies came at the wrong times; the people could not bear the burden.

sentences.zh: 河東尚未歸命，西路酋帥亦相黨附，夙夜以思，制之之術，惟推心庶僚、和協軍情、撫綏百姓三者而已。

translations.literal: Hedong had not yet submitted; chieftains of the western route likewise banded together. Thinking day and night, the means to control them were only three: trusting the common staff, harmonizing army morale, and comforting the people.
translations.idiomatic: Hedong had not yet submitted, and chieftains of the western route likewise banded together. Thinking day and night, the means to control them were only three: trusting the common staff, harmonizing army morale, and comforting the people.

sentences.zh: 今所歸順凡七十六處，得戶一百九萬百一十八。

translations.literal: Those who have now submitted number seventy-six places in all, yielding one million nine hundred one thousand one hundred eighteen households.
translations.idiomatic: Those who have now submitted number seventy-six places in all, yielding one million nine hundred one thousand one hundred eighteen households.

sentences.zh: 非汴州炎熱，水土難居，止得一年，太平可指掌而致。

translations.literal: But for Bian's heat and its hard soil and water to live on, we could stay only one year; peace could be achieved as easily as pointing to the palm of one's hand.
translations.idiomatic: But for Bian's heat and its hard soil and water, we could stay only one year; peace could be achieved as easily as pointing to the palm of one's hand.

sentences.zh: 且改鎮州為中京，以備巡幸。

translations.literal: Moreover Zhen Prefecture was renamed Central Capital to serve imperial tours.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover Zhen Prefecture was renamed Central Capital to serve imperial tours.

sentences.zh: 欲伐河東，姑俟別圖。

translations.literal: We mean to attack Hedong, but for the present await another plan.
translations.idiomatic: We mean to attack Hedong, but for the present await another plan.

sentences.zh: 其概如此。

translations.literal: Such is the general outline.
translations.idiomatic: Such is the general outline.

sentences.zh: 」戊辰，次高邑，不豫。

translations.literal: " On wuchen day he halted at Gaoyi; he fell ill.
translations.idiomatic: " On wuchen day he halted at Gaoyi and fell ill.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，崩于欒城，年四十六。

translations.literal: On dingchou day he died at Luancheng, aged forty-six.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day he died at Luancheng, aged forty-six.

sentences.zh: 是歲九月壬子朔，葬于鳳山，陵曰懷陵，廟號太宗。

translations.literal: That year, on the renzi new moon of the ninth month, he was buried at Phoenix Mountain; his tomb was called Huai Ling; his temple name was Taizong.
translations.idiomatic: That year, on the renzi new moon of the ninth month, he was buried at Phoenix Mountain; his tomb was called Huai Ling, and his temple name was Taizong.

sentences.zh: 統和二十六年七月，上尊諡孝武皇帝。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year of Tonghe, seventh month, he was posthumously titled Filial Martial Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year of Tonghe, seventh month, he was posthumously titled Filial Martial Emperor.

sentences.zh: 重熙二十一年九月，增諡孝武惠文皇帝。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year of Chongxi, ninth month, his posthumous title was augmented to Filial Martial, Bountiful and Cultured Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year of Chongxi, ninth month, his posthumous title was augmented to Filial Martial, Bountiful and Cultured Emperor.

sentences.zh: 贊曰：太宗甫定多方，遠近向化。

translations.literal: The encomium reads: Scarcely had Taizong settled the many regions when near and far turned to his transformation.
translations.idiomatic: The encomium reads: Scarcely had Taizong settled the many regions when near and far turned to his rule.

sentences.zh: 建國號，備典章，至於厘庶政，閱名實，錄囚徒，教耕織，配鰥寡。

translations.literal: He established the dynastic title, prepared statutes and regulations, put common government in order, reviewed names and reality, recorded prisoners, taught planting and weaving, and matched widowers and widows.
translations.idiomatic: He established the dynastic title, prepared statutes and regulations, put common government in order, reviewed names and reality, recorded prisoners, taught planting and weaving, and matched widowers and widows.

sentences.zh: 求直言之士，得郎君海思，即擢宣徽。

translations.literal: Seeking men of frank counsel, he found Gentleman Haisi and immediately promoted him to Commissioner of the Palace Domestic Service.
translations.idiomatic: Seeking men of frank counsel, he found Yelü Haisi and immediately promoted him to Commissioner of the Palace Domestic Service.

sentences.zh: 嘉唐張敬達忠于其君，卒以禮葬。

translations.literal: He praised Tang's Zhang Jingda for loyalty to his ruler and at last buried him with full rites.
translations.idiomatic: He praised Tang's Zhang Jingda for loyalty to his ruler and at last buried him with full rites.

sentences.zh: 輟游豫而納三克之清，憫士卒而下休養之令。

translations.literal: He gave up pleasure excursions and heeded Sanko's plain counsel; he pitied the soldiers and issued orders for rest and recuperation.
translations.idiomatic: He gave up pleasure excursions and heeded Sanko's plain counsel; he pitied the soldiers and issued orders for rest and recuperation.

sentences.zh: 親征晉國，重貴面縛。

translations.literal: He personally campaigned against Jin, and Chonggui came bound with cords before him.
translations.idiomatic: He personally campaigned against Jin, and Chonggui came bound with cords before him.

sentences.zh: 斯可謂威德兼弘，英略間見者矣。

translations.literal: This may be called combining majesty and virtue, with heroic strategy appearing here and there.
translations.idiomatic: This may be called combining majesty and virtue, with heroic strategy appearing here and there.

sentences.zh: 入汴之後，無幾微之驕，有「三失」之訓。

translations.literal: After entering Bian, there was no slightest trace of pride; there was the admonition of the "Three Faults."
translations.idiomatic: After entering Bian, there was no slightest trace of pride; there was the admonition of the "Three Faults."

sentences.zh: 《傳》稱鄭伯之善處勝，《書》進《秦誓》之能悔過，太宗蓋兼有之，其卓矣乎！

translations.literal: The 《Commentary》 praises the Duke of Zheng's skill in handling victory; the 《Documents》 advances the 《Qin Oath》 for the ability to repent of faults — Taizong surely combined both. How lofty he was!
translations.idiomatic: The 《Commentary》 praises the Duke of Zheng's skill in handling victory; the 《Documents》 advances the 《Qin Oath》 for the ability to repent of wrongdoing — Taizong surely combined both. How outstanding!
